feature: Productivity features for desktop users
description: The desktop client adds advanced filters for rows and totals, row-based copy and paste, improved keyboard navigation and shortcuts, and the Tell Me search window. These changes speed up work with lists and help users find pages and actions.

feature: Accessibility features for desktop users
description: Desktop accessibility improvements. The original source and deployment availability require further verification.

feature: Refreshed experience on major desktop screens
description: A refreshed interface across role centers, lists, worksheets, documents, and detail pages in the browser and Windows 10 app.

feature: Business Central everywhere
description: Business Central became available for cloud, hybrid, and on-premises deployments, with the on-premises option succeeding Dynamics NAV.

feature: Combined mobile/companion app for Business Central
description: A unified mobile experience for accessing Business Central. The original source and deployment availability require further verification.

feature: Enhanced Power BI embed experience
description: The enhanced Power BI integration automatically deploys and selects default reports on first sign-in. Users can personalize embedded reports on their Business Central home page and manage them from a page in Business Central.

feature: Tenant administration for VARs
description: Partners can manage tenant health, troubleshooting, notifications, and sandboxes through the Business Central administration center.

feature: Improved Visual Studio Code AL experience
description: Improves extension development and troubleshooting with stronger breakpoint support, inline help, and event tracing for a user scenario. The release also adds extension support for enums, report datasets, and field groups, plus .NET interoperability for on-premises deployments.

feature: Localization apps and translation apps
description: Microsoft described a localization strategy combining Microsoft-led and partner-led models, including localization extensions.

feature: Intelligent edge for Dynamics GP, Dynamics SL, and Dynamics NAV
description: Replicate data from on-premises Dynamics solutions to the cloud using Intelligent Edge. The original source and deployment availability require further verification.

feature: Non-Inventory item type
description: Use the Non-Inventory item type for items that do not require inventory tracking.

feature: Document line tracking
description: Shows documents related to a sales or purchase order line, including archived orders, shipments, receipts, invoices, and blanket orders. Users can open either a related line or its full document to trace how the order was processed.

feature: Improved report layouts
description: The October 2018 release improved the layout of 31 reports.

feature: Create Company assisted setup improvements
description: Extends the guided company-creation process with a user setup step and the option to skip accounting-period setup. This helps administrators choose which setup tasks to complete while creating a company.

feature: Late payment predictions
description: The opt-in Late Payment Prediction extension uses a predictive model to flag posted sales invoices likely to be paid late. Collections teams can review the predicted late payments and confidence levels in customer ledger entries, then prioritize follow-up or review payment terms.

feature: Support for Azure SQL Database Managed Instance
description: Business Central on-premises can use Azure SQL Database Managed Instance to host its database. This lets administrators run Business Central on-premises software with a managed SQL database service in Azure.

feature: Create payment journal lines from selected ledger entries
description: The Create Payment action transfers selected open customer or vendor ledger entries into the appropriate journal. Users can select vendor invoices to pay or customer invoices for which to register payment.

feature: Switch between simplified and standard journal views
description: General, purchase, and sales journals offer a simplified view with fewer columns. The general journal shows debit and credit fields, and purchase and sales journals restrict account types to those relevant to their tasks. Users can return to the standard view for advanced work.

feature: Warn about unreleased sales and purchase orders needed by the warehouse
description: Business Central warns users who close an unreleased sales or purchase order when a line has a quantity, a location is specified, and that location requires the corresponding warehouse handling. Releasing the order makes it available for warehouse processing.

feature: Permission sets are editable
description: Administrators can create permission sets or copy existing sets into editable user-defined sets. They can opt in to notifications when an original set changes, import a permission-set definition, and use Effective Permissions to see which sets grant a user access.

feature: Named-user licensing scenarios in cumulative update 01
description: Business Central on-premises gained additional named-user licensing scenarios in cumulative update 01, with support for product line IDs 49, 74, 75, and 76. Customers upgrading from the October 2018 release must obtain a new license for CU 01 and later. The new license is incompatible with the original release.

feature: Norway — Support EHF 3.0 electronic invoices
description: The Norwegian localization supports the EHF 3.0 electronic invoicing format introduced for 2019. Businesses can configure customers to receive electronic sales documents in the required format.

feature: United Kingdom — Submit VAT returns through Making Tax Digital
description: The British localization adds the Making Tax Digital extension for VAT reporting. After connecting Business Central to HM Revenue and Customs, users can retrieve VAT obligations and submit VAT returns electronically.

feature: Germany — ELSTER VAT Localization extension
description: The German on-premises localization delivers ELSTER VAT functionality through the ELSTER VAT Localization for Germany extension. When upgrading the German version from cumulative update 02 or earlier, publish and install Elster.app to use the updated functionality. Businesses can use the extension to prepare and export VAT advance notifications for the German tax authorities.

feature: Belgium — Recognize IBANs in CODA statement imports
description: CODA statement import recognizes the IBAN as the bank account identifier in the Belgian localization. This lets finance teams import electronic bank statements that identify the account by IBAN.

feature: Monitor SQL Server deadlocks with file-based event targets
description: Business Central Server can read SQL Server deadlock events from a file-based Extended Events target instead of the default in-memory buffer. The file target provides more capacity for high-volume databases and requires server-side configuration.

feature: Italy — Support attachments in FatturaPA invoice XML
description: The Italian localization adds attachment support to FatturaPA XML. Supporting documents can travel with the electronic invoice in the Italian invoice format.

feature: Italy — Export self-billing sales invoices as XML
description: The Italian localization supports the XML output required for self-billing sales invoices when a sales document has not been created.

feature: Support an additional reporting currency on VAT returns
description: VAT return reporting can use the additional reporting currency. This supports companies that maintain an additional currency for financial reporting and need to prepare a VAT return using it.

feature: Norway — Structure KID references in SEPA credit transfers
description: The Norwegian localization uses the structured remittance section of the SEPA credit transfer pain.001.001.03 file for the KID payment reference. This lets the payment file carry the reference in the format used to identify the payment.

feature: Mexico — Generate third-party VAT declarations with DIOT
description: The Mexican DIOT extension prepares a third-party VAT declaration from vendor purchase transactions. Users configure DIOT reporting, generate the declaration, and export a file for submission to the Mexican tax authority, SAT.

feature: Germany — Export GDPdU and GoBD audit files in UTF-8
description: The German digital audit data export supports UTF-8 encoding for GDPdU and GoBD audit files. This lets businesses produce UTF-8 data files when preparing accounting records for a digital audit.

feature: Quick Entry
description: Speeds up repetitive keyboard-based data entry by moving the Enter key through a configurable sequence of important editable fields instead of the normal tab order. Users can personalize which fields are included, and the path can expand collapsed sections when necessary.

feature: Focus mode
description: Expands the selected document line section to provide more room for reviewing or entering lines, while hiding the FactBox. Users can toggle the view using its button or Ctrl+Shift+F12 and apply advanced filters to the expanded lines.

feature: Page inspection
description: Helps users and support staff troubleshoot a page by showing the underlying page and table identifiers, field values, applied filters, and extensions affecting the page or table. Open it from the page or with Ctrl+Alt+F1 without leaving the current work.

feature: Improved search
description: Improves Tell Me search with alternative business terms and results for partner solutions in AppSource. For example, users can search for product to find the Items page; developers can define additional terms for pages and reports.

feature: Improved list scrolling
description: Improves the responsiveness of large lists by loading rows on demand, speeding up initial display and keyboard navigation. Users can scroll with the keyboard or scrollbar without stopping at a fetching-more-rows message.

feature: Longer name and description fields
description: Increases Name and Description fields from 50 to 100 characters across master data, documents, journals, and ledger entries. The unit-of-measure description limit also increases from 10 to 50 characters, allowing more descriptive business data.

feature: Physical inventory counting
description: Uses Physical Inventory Orders and related Physical Inventory Recordings to organize a count, distribute work, and capture quantities. This document-based process improves control over larger counts compared with relying on journals alone.

feature: Bulk import item pictures
description: Imports multiple item pictures together instead of adding them to cards one by one. Name each image after its item number, package the images in a ZIP file, and use the Import Item Pictures page to select and import them.

feature: Select multiple items on sales and purchase documents
description: Adds several items to a sales or purchase document in one operation through the Select Items line action. On sales documents, the Default Item Quantity setting can prefill the quantity for the selected items.

feature: Merge duplicate records
description: Combines duplicate customer, vendor, or contact records into one, helping clean up master data. The user compares the records and selects the values to retain; the MERGE DUPLICATES permission set is required.

feature: Enter shortcut dimensions directly on document and journal lines
description: Configured shortcut dimensions appear as fields on document and journal lines alongside the two global dimensions. Users can enter values directly on the line and make the relevant columns visible without opening the Dimensions page.

feature: Calculate sales quote expiration with a validity policy
description: Enter a date formula in Sales & Receivables Setup to calculate the Quote Valid Until Date on sales quotes. The calculation lets sales teams apply a consistent expiration policy to new quotes.

feature: Copy configuration templates for master data
description: Copy an existing configuration template when creating a new one. Templates can hold defaults for records such as customers, vendors, items, and contacts, so you can reuse a similar configuration.

feature: Look up SWIFT codes when setting up bank accounts
description: Maintain a list of SWIFT codes for the banks you work with and select a code from the list when setting up a bank account. This reduces manual re-entry of codes during payment setup.

feature: Select reports for warehouse documents
description: Use Report Selection to choose the reports printed for warehouse documents, including picks, put-aways, and shipments. This lets warehouse teams use the appropriate report for each document type.

feature: Schedule background jobs and reports with a date formula
description: Use a relative date formula to calculate the next run of a job queue entry or scheduled report. For example, a report can run at the beginning of each month using a formula tied to the calendar period.

feature: Edit descriptions on posted general ledger entries
description: Edit the Description field directly on a posted general ledger entry to correct or clarify the text. Use Change Log Entries to view changes recorded for the Description field.

feature: Require approval user setup before starting approval workflows
description: Business Central checks that the person starting an approval workflow is configured on the Approval User Setup page. This catches a missing user setup before the workflow starts.

feature: Show vendor invoice numbers in purchase invoice and credit memo lists
description: The purchase invoice and purchase credit memo lists show the Vendor Invoice No. column so users can identify documents using the reference supplied by the vendor.

feature: Show transaction creation times in registers
description: General ledger, item, and job registers can display the time each transaction was created. Use the time as well as the date to locate transactions in a busy register.

feature: Carry external document numbers to posted sales invoices and shipments
description: The external document number from a sales order carries over to its posted sales invoice and shipment. Users can search posted documents using the customer’s purchase order number.

feature: Copy item descriptions and customer and vendor names to ledger entries
description: Enable the corresponding options in Inventory Setup, Sales & Receivables Setup, or Purchases & Payables Setup to copy item descriptions and customer and vendor names to their ledger entries. The descriptive information makes posted entries easier to identify.

feature: View document attachments from ledger entries and payment application
description: Open attachments from the related sales or purchase document in customer or vendor ledger entries and while applying payments. For example, a user can retrieve an original supplier invoice while settling the payment.

feature: Set a default ship-to address for each customer
description: Select a Ship-to Code on the customer card to fill in the default shipping address on new sales documents. Users can override it for an individual order.

feature: Review and export RapidStart configuration package errors
description: See validation and import errors for an entire configuration package. Filter by error text, field, or table, inspect the source record, and export the filtered errors to Excel for follow-up.

feature: Preview Excel imports into configuration packages
description: Review the packages and tables in an Excel file before importing it. The preview shows whether the import action creates a package or updates an existing one and whether it adds or updates table lines.

feature: Preview posting for prepayment invoices and credit memos
description: Preview the ledger entries that would be created by posting a sales or purchase prepayment invoice or credit memo. The preview lets users review the posting impact before posting.

feature: Control item creation prompts on sales and purchase documents
description: Inventory setup can suppress the prompt shown for an item that cannot be found. Sales and purchase setup separately control whether users can enter an item number that is not yet in Business Central.

feature: Copy customer default dimensions to new jobs
description: When a job is created for a customer, the customer’s default dimension values are copied to the job. Users can adjust the copied values for the individual job.

feature: Extend the G/L account Where-Used search to localizations and extensions
description: The G/L account Where-Used search includes setup references from local functionality and extensions. Extensions can subscribe to an event to register the relationship between their setup table and the G/L Account table.

feature: Set default Intrastat transaction types for service documents
description: Intrastat setup supports a default transaction type for service documents. The default provides a consistent transaction classification for service-related documents in the Intrastat workflow.

feature: Norway — Export Standard Audit Files for Tax (SAF-T)
description: The Norwegian localization prepares and exports SAF-T financial data for submission to the Norwegian tax authorities on request. Users configure mappings and select a reporting period before generating the export. Microsoft documented the feature in Spring 2019 CU 04 and later in October 2018 CU 13.

feature: Italy — Filter the VAT report by VAT business posting group
description: The Italian VAT report can be filtered by VAT business posting group. Finance teams can restrict the report to transactions assigned to selected business posting groups.

feature: Norway — Print KID payment references on sales documents
description: Sales documents in the Norwegian localization can print the KID payment reference. Customers can use the printed reference when making payments.

feature: Allow different currencies for non-euro SEPA payments
description: The update removes the restriction on using different currencies for non-euro SEPA payments, allowing currency combinations that the previous validation blocked.

feature: Italy — Support Fattura document types in electronic invoicing
description: The Italian electronic invoicing solution supports the Fattura Document Type. The type identifies the kind of document being reported in the FatturaPA electronic invoice.

feature: Norway — Check data for SAF-T exports
description: The Norwegian SAF-T solution includes a Data Check that helps users identify issues in the information used to prepare an audit file before submitting the export.

feature: Control the processing order of data exchange mappings
description: Data Exchange Definition Mapping supports a processing order. Configure the order when a data exchange requires mappings to be applied in a particular sequence.

feature: Netherlands — Preview ICP declaration XML before submission
description: The Dutch localization can display the XML request for an ICP declaration before submission, giving users a chance to review the outgoing payload.

feature: Record an EORI number in Company Information
description: Business Central can store the company’s Economic Operators Registration and Identification number in Company Information so it is available for customs-related processes.

feature: Include partner tax identification numbers in Intrastat reports
description: Intrastat reporting supports including trading partner tax identification numbers in the reports that require the new information from 2021.

feature: Italy — Set Fattura document types in VAT Posting Setup
description: In the Italian localization, Fattura document types can be specified in VAT Posting Setup. Users can configure the document type used by the electronic invoicing process directly in the VAT setup.

feature: Norway — Include currency information in SAF-T general ledger exports
description: The Norwegian SAF-T export includes currency information for general ledger entries. This supplies currency context alongside the accounting entries in the audit file.

feature: Denmark — Include the country code in Intrastat VAT registration numbers
description: The Danish Intrastat Setup has an option to include a country code with the VAT registration number used for Intrastat reporting.

feature: Belgium — Use extended text on VAT clauses
description: The Belgian localization supports extended text for VAT clauses. This lets users maintain expanded clause wording for local VAT documentation.

feature: Switzerland — Enter an amount for Swiss QR bills without a total
description: Users can enter the amount manually when a Swiss QR bill does not encode an amount. This allows payment processing for open-amount QR bills.

feature: Cancel issued reminders and finance charge memos
description: Lets users cancel reminders and finance charge memos that have already been issued, correcting the follow-up process when a notice should no longer remain active.

feature: Copy line descriptions to G/L entries when posting
description: Copies the descriptions from document lines to the resulting general ledger entries during posting, making posted transactions easier to identify and audit.

feature: Copy documents when some lines are blocked
description: Improves Copy Document so users can handle documents that contain blocked lines when copying data into a new document.

feature: Add links to navigation menu
description: Lets users add links to pages in the Role Center navigation menu for quicker access to frequently used Business Central tasks.

feature: Resize columns with fewer clicks
description: Simplifies column resizing in lists so users can adjust the width of displayed data with fewer interactions.

feature: Filter option fields by multiple values
description: Allows users to filter option fields by multiple values, making list filters more flexible when several option values are relevant.

feature: Save and personalize list views
description: Lets users save filtered and personalized list views so they can return to the same working set without recreating the filters and layout.

feature: Enhancements to Excel integration
description: Improves the web client integration with Excel so users can work with workbook data from Business Central more smoothly.

feature: Filter information in reports
description: Improves filters on report request pages, making it easier to specify the data a report processes.

feature: Multitasking across multiple pages
description: Allows users to keep multiple Business Central pages open in browser tabs and move between tasks without losing their place.

feature: Customize a user profile without code
description: Lets users customize a profile from the client without development, tailoring role-center pages and actions to the needs of a user group.

feature: AL-only application platform
description: Delivers the Base Application as an AL extension and retires the C/SIDE development environment and C/AL application model for this major release.

feature: Multiple production environments
description: Administrators can create and manage more than one Business Central online production environment under the same tenant. Separate environments can support different business units or localizations.

feature: Report production outage in the Business Central Administration Center
description: Administrators can report a production environment outage directly from the administration center. The action opens a support ticket with the environment information needed for Microsoft to investigate.

feature: Identify the company by a badge
description: Configure a company-specific badge in Company Information. The badge appears in the web client and helps users distinguish the company they are working in when switching between companies.

feature: Personalize actions on your Role Center
description: Use personalization to show, hide, and move actions or action groups on your Role Center. This lets you keep frequently used actions visible in the places where you work.

feature: Add notes and links to data
description: Users can attach notes and links to business records in the modern client. This keeps supporting context and references accessible from the records they describe.

feature: Access modifiers
description: AL access modifiers let developers control which objects and members other code can use. They can expose supported APIs and restrict implementation details to the defining extension or scope.

feature: Ability to download a database export file
description: Business Central online administrators can request and download an environment database export. The exported database can be retained for use outside the hosted environment.

feature: Add the Name 2 field to customer and vendor cards
description: Allows users to personalize customer and vendor cards and lists to show the Name 2 field. The additional field stores longer legal names and supports exporting them, which helps organizations whose names do not fit in a single field.

feature: Include job information in archived sales and purchase documents
description: Retains job-related information when sales or purchase quotes and orders are archived. This lets users review project information from earlier document versions as a quote or order changes during negotiations.

feature: Use VAT clauses on different document types
description: Allows a business to define different VAT clauses by document type, such as an invoice or credit memo. The appropriate exemption text can explain why a reduced or zero VAT rate is applied on each document.

feature: View item availability by unit of measure
description: Shows available item quantities by unit of measure from the item list or document lines. This helps order processors assess availability in the units customers request when agreeing on shipping dates.

feature: View the number of general journal lines
description: Displays a count of lines at the bottom of a general journal. Users importing large journals or opening balances can compare the count with the source, because a balanced journal alone does not prove that every line was imported.

feature: View customers' contact and document info on sales documents
description: Displays the customer reference and external document number on sales quotes, orders, invoices, credit memos, and associated reports. These references help staff find the correct sales document when a customer asks about their purchase order.

feature: Skip empty lines in the Account Schedule report
description: Offers a Skip Empty Lines option on the Account Schedule report request page. It removes lines without data from reports such as balance sheets, profit and loss statements, and cash flow statements to make the output easier to review.

feature: MICR fonts available in Business Central online
description: Provides MICR E13-B and CMC-7 fonts and security fonts in Business Central online production and sandbox environments. Custom check layouts that use these fonts can therefore be rendered online; developers need suitable local fonts when designing layouts.

feature: New events to unblock printer extensions in Business Central online
description: Provides events that let extensions register printers and react when a report is ready to print. Developers can define printer options such as paper trays and copies, then route generated documents to a cloud-printing provider.

feature: Sign-in attempt telemetry in Application Insights for partners
description: Emits telemetry for successful and failed sign-in attempts and company-opening operations, including failure reasons. Partners can analyze the data in Application Insights to identify access or permission problems and help customers troubleshoot them.

feature: View Your Reference and External Document No. on sales documents
description: If your sales document includes the customer's reference information, such as their purchase order number, you can more easily look up the sales document when the customer calls. This way, your response time for the customer's questions is much shorter. It is essential that this data flows through the sales process from quote to posted invoices. You can now view the Your Reference and External Document No. fields on sales quotes, orders, invoices, and credit memos. The fields are also included in the related reports. feature: Pages open faster
description: Caches page structure so frequently used pages can render while fresh data loads, without saving business data to the device. Update 16.3 extends the cache across sessions for supported pages.

feature: Auto-insert recurring sales and purchase lines
description: Configure recurring sales and purchase lines so that Business Central offers or inserts them when creating the relevant document. On sales documents, it can insert a single eligible set automatically or prompt the user to choose between eligible sets.

feature: Switzerland — QR-Bill management
description: The Swiss localization supports QR bills. Users can capture the payment details printed in the QR code and use them when processing payables. Microsoft lists general availability on April 1, 2020 for the 2020 release wave 1, and documents support in the Spring 2019 branch from cumulative update 12.

feature: Company lifecycle telemetry in Application Insights for partners
description: Emits telemetry for company creation, copying, and deletion, including failure reasons. Partners can use the traces to monitor company lifecycle operations and investigate failures.

feature: Migrate data from Business Central 14.x on-premises to Business Central 15.x online
description: Uses the cloud migration extension to move data from an April 2019 on-premises installation to Business Central online without first performing an on-premises upgrade.

feature: Update error telemetry in Application Insights for partners
description: Reports exceptions from update codeunits with the codeunit, AL stack trace, and error message so partners can diagnose extension update failures.

feature: New URL parameter hides web client header
description: Adds the showHeader URL parameter so embedded or focused web-client scenarios can hide the Microsoft 365 header. Hiding the header also removes access to its actions, such as sign-out and the app launcher.

feature: Improved user experience to keep things from going wrong
description: Adds visual and contextual safeguards, including prominent document statuses, context-sensitive actions, and mandatory-field indicators, to help users spot problems before processing documents or journals.

feature: Use modern authentication to connect to Microsoft Dataverse and Dynamics 365 Sales
description: Supports modern authentication for the connection between Business Central and Dataverse or Dynamics 365 Sales, aligning synchronization and integration with current Microsoft identity and security practices.

feature: Extension lifecycle telemetry in Application Insights for partners
description: Emits success and failure signals for extension synchronization, installation, update, and uninstallation, including failure reasons. Update 17.1 adds extension-level telemetry support for ISVs.

feature: Client pageview telemetry in Application Insights for partners
description: Sends client page-view signals to Application Insights so administrators and partners can understand usage and investigate browser or client-side performance problems.

feature: Page layout is now cached to browser storage
description: When navigating across pages to complete their tasks, business users expect snappy loading of pages and dialog boxes. Users will find that the pages they use often are now quicker to open. The structure of the page is shown first, giving context until data is loaded. Technically, the rendered page is now cached the first time it is opened. This is done without persisting any business data or sensitive information to the user's device. The next time the page opens, it will immediately render from the cache while the latest data is fetched from the service. - In Update 16.0, pages are cached for the duration of the user's session. Users will only benefit from the performance gains while they remain signed in....

feature: Review payment matches and report bank reconciliations
description: The Bank Account Reconciliation page provides more space to compare bank statement lines with ledger entries, and a report covers ongoing and posted reconciliations. The Payment Reconciliation Journal adds Match Details and lets users review, adjust, accept, or reject payment matches.

feature: Installing Marketplace apps updates in the Business Central administration center
description: Admins can discover and install Marketplace app updates for a Business Central online environment directly in the administration center. Availability rolled out gradually in 16.2. In 16.3 Microsoft confirmed that customers could discover and install all Marketplace app updates.

feature: Use Business Central build artifacts with generic Docker images
description: Microsoft publishes Business Central builds as artifacts starting with 16.4. Developers use an artifact with a generic Docker image to create a container for the desired Business Central build.

feature: Delete extension data
description: Adds an explicit Delete Extension Data option when uninstalling an extension, allowing administrators to remove the data owned by that extension after confirmation.

feature: Business Central in Microsoft Teams
description: Connects Business Central and Teams so users can share records as compact cards and view or act on details in a Teams conversation. Microsoft lists general availability of the Teams app in update 17.4.

feature: OAuth 2.0 for Outlook add-in deployment
description: Uses OAuth 2.0 to deploy the Outlook add-in, replacing less secure authentication patterns and improving the security of its Microsoft 365 connection.

feature: Database and file capacity management
description: Mostra capacita database/file e relativo consumo nell Admin Center.

feature: Unlimited additional production environments
description: Lets customers purchase additional production environments, each with associated sandbox environments, to support additional workloads and testing needs.

feature: Service-to-service authentication for Automation APIs
description: Supports OAuth client-credentials authentication for external services that call Business Central Automation APIs, enabling unattended integrations without a user sign-in.

feature: Feature Management data update scheduling
description: Lets administrators schedule data updates required by features enabled through Feature Management, so those updates can run at a suitable time.

feature: Faster low-level code calculation
description: Improves low-level code calculation for supply-chain planning, reducing the processing needed to determine component levels in production structures.

feature: Copy lines from posted general journals
description: When Copy to Posted Jnl. Lines is enabled on a general journal template, Business Central retains posted lines so users can copy them back into a journal. A batch can be copied with a different posting date or with opposite signs when preparing a correction.

feature: Track record creation and modification with data audit system fields
description: The platform stores system fields that identify when a record was created or modified and which user performed the operation. Developers can read them to show record history or use them in reports and integrations.

feature: Company Hub
description: The Company Hub extension shows financial indicators and links for companies across connected Business Central online environments. Users select Company Hub as their role or open its page directly, after receiving the required permissions.

feature: Check financial journals in the background
description: Enable background error checking for a journal batch to review issues while entering journal lines. Open the Journal Check FactBox for details, or use Show Lines with Issues to focus on affected lines before posting.

feature: Export consolidation files for Dynamics 365 Finance
description: A business unit can use the Finance and Operations file format when exporting consolidation data. This lets a subsidiary send financial data to a parent company that consolidates in Dynamics 365 Finance without a separate file transformation.

feature: Enhanced email capabilities
description: Improves email communication with support for multiple accounts, distribution groups, and attachment management, enabling businesses to send documents through modern email providers.

feature: Use new sales pricing experience
description: Provides administration and user experiences built on the extensible price calculation engine, including tools to review the price calculation methods available in an environment.

feature: Control how Account Schedules for core financial reports are generated
description: Lets users choose whether to preserve existing account schedules and create new ones, or overwrite existing schedules when G/L account categories and financial reports change.

feature: Improved VAT Registration no. lookup
description: Uses the VIES service to validate VAT registration numbers and, where supported by national authorities, related company information such as addresses.

feature: Use environmentType and environmentName launch.json properties instead of obsoleted sandboxName
description: Updates AL launch configuration to identify the target environment using environment type and name instead of the deprecated sandboxName setting.

feature: Extension lifecycle telemetry in Application Insights for ISVs
description: Adds Application Insights telemetry for extension lifecycle events, giving ISVs data to monitor installation, upgrade, and other extension operations in customer environments.

feature: Symbols can be downloaded with a snapshot initialize launch.json configuration, using above environment properties
description: Enables snapshot debugging to download AL symbols using the environment properties defined in the snapshot initialization launch configuration, supporting debugging against the correct Business Central environment.

feature: Notify users of high-risk changes in selected setup fields
description: Field Monitoring Setup lets administrators select sensitive fields and receive email notifications when their values change. This helps them follow changes to sensitive setup or master data and review the recorded activity.

feature: Process OData batch requests as a transaction
description: API clients can request transactional OData batch processing by setting snapshot isolation. If an operation fails, Business Central rolls back changes in the current transaction. An explicit AL commit creates a transaction boundary, so changes already committed can remain.

feature: Application Performance Improvements
description: Moves calculations for selected customer and vendor statistics FactBoxes to background tasks to reduce page loading time.

feature: Signal from job queue execution added to Application Insights telemetry for partners
description: Emits signals when job queue entries are enqueued, started, completed, stopped, or cancelled, helping administrators monitor background jobs and investigate failures.

feature: Signal from permission changes to added to Application Insights telemetry for partners
description: Emits telemetry for changes to permission sets and their assignments, including user-defined sets and changes made by extensions.

feature: Signal from the retention policy feature added to Application Insights telemetry for partners
description: Emits events for retention-policy configuration and data deletion so partners and customers can monitor use of retention policies.

feature: Signal from the sensitive field audit feature added to Application Insights telemetry for partners
description: Emits monitoring events for sensitive business fields, enabling partners to analyze changes to information such as bank details after field monitoring is configured.

feature: Signal from the email feature added to Application Insights telemetry for partners
description: Emits email telemetry for successful and failed sending, helping administrators investigate email delivery problems.

feature: Signal from application packages lifecycle added to Application Insights Telemetry for partners
description: Emits lifecycle telemetry for configuration package operations such as import, export, application, and deletion.

feature: Snapshot Debugging
description: Records server-side AL execution as a snapshot that developers can inspect later in Visual Studio Code, including production-cloud scenarios supported from update 17.2.

feature: Restoring an Environment in the Admin Center
description: Allows an administrator to restore an environment to a point within the applicable backup retention period to recover from data corruption or deletion.

feature: Use Shortcut dimensions in G/L Entries for Financial reporting
description: Makes configured shortcut dimensions available on entry pages so users can filter financial information by values such as area and export those columns for analysis.

feature: Signal from web service key authentication added to Application Insights telemetry for partners
description: Emits telemetry for successful and failed web-service access-key authentication. Microsoft subsequently deprecated and stopped supporting access keys for Business Central online; use OAuth for current online integrations.

feature: Handle Price List Exceptions with Allow Updating Defaults
description: Allows selected defaults such as currency and effective dates to be changed on individual price-list lines, supporting exceptions to the list-wide values.

feature: Use recurring journals to allocate balances by dimension values
description: Adds recurring journal methods and dimension filters that allocate costs using G/L account balances for selected dimension values.

feature: The Business Central app for Microsoft Teams reaches General Availability
description: Make decisions faster as a team by bringing business data into Microsoft Teams, the hub for collaboration in Microsoft 365. Whether you're in conversation with coworkers, preparing cross-department financial budgets, or bringing roles together for an important project, the Business Central app for Teams streamlines conversations and allows you to act on your Business Central data without leaving Microsoft Teams. The new Business Central app for Teams provides two distinct but related features that help streamline conversations and empower users to act on their business data without leaving Microsoft Teams: - Paste a link to any Business Central record into Microsoft Teams chat, and it will expand that into...

feature: Netherlands — Add Partner VAT ID and country of origin to Intrastat reporting
description: Adds the Partner VAT ID and country or region of origin data required for Dutch Intrastat reporting, improving the information included in the exported declaration.

feature: Spain — Use sales invoices as substitution documents for SII
description: Allows a sales invoice to be used as a substitution document in Spain’s Immediate Supply of Information (SII) process, supporting correction and replacement of previously reported documents.

feature: Spain — Report goods and services together in SII foreign-customer documents
description: Supports reporting deliveries of goods and services together in a single SII document for a foreign customer, covering transactions that include both types of supply. Microsoft records the on-premises change in 14.23 and also lists it in updates 15.16 and 17.5.

feature: Germany — Support additional ciphers in preliminary VAT returns
description: Adds support for the Kz37 and Kz50 ciphers in Germany’s preliminary VAT return and advance notification, allowing the relevant tax data to be reported in the required fields. Microsoft documents the on-premises change in 14.22 and lists it again in update 17.5.

feature: Belgium — Control inclusion in the VAT Annual Listing
description: Adds a field that controls whether a customer is included in Belgium’s VAT Annual Listing, allowing businesses to reflect the applicable reporting treatment for each customer.

feature: Norway — Improve SAF-T export of contact and postal code data
description: Improves the Norwegian SAF-T audit file export by including corrected contact and postal-code information in the exported data.

feature: Automatic item tracking cards
description: Creates item-tracking information cards automatically for lots and serial numbers, helping users access tracking details from related inventory records.

feature: Bank reconciliation improvements
description: Improves bank reconciliation rules, reporting, and visibility so users can match bank statement transactions and investigate reconciliation differences more effectively.

feature: Default bins for jobs
description: Propone ubicazioni/bin predefiniti su righe commessa e registrazioni.

feature: Define lot sizes for production stages
description: Lets manufacturers define lot sizes for production stages, giving them more control over how quantities are grouped and processed through production.

feature: Navigate from non-editable fields to related records
description: Makes eligible non-editable fields navigable so users can open the related record directly and inspect its details without searching for it separately.

feature: Double-click records in lists
description: Lets users open a selected record by double-clicking it in a list, providing a quicker way to move from list results to the record card.

feature: Restrict allowed values for mandatory default dimensions
description: When a default dimension is set to Code Mandatory, finance users can specify which values are allowed for the record. Business Central then requires a value from that list when users post a transaction.

feature: Apply payments to employee ledger entries in the payment reconciliation journal
description: The Payment Reconciliation Journal can apply bank payments to employee ledger entries, such as employee expense reimbursements. This extends payment matching beyond customer and vendor entries.

feature: Import bank statement flat files using column mapping
description: Configure an import mapping from the columns of CSV or text bank transaction files to Business Central fields. The setup supports comma- and semicolon-separated files for importing statement lines into bank reconciliation.

feature: Correct dimensions on G/L entries
description: Use Correct Dimensions on posted general ledger entries to change dimension values, add dimensions, or remove them without changing the posted amounts. Administrators can restrict dimension corrections and use the change log to review or revert changes.

feature: United Kingdom — Configure fraud prevention headers for Making Tax Digital
description: Adds configurable fraud prevention headers for the UK Making Tax Digital integration, allowing the required client and network information to be provided with VAT submissions. Microsoft documents the on-premises change in 14.25 and lists it again in update 18.2. The 13.10 on-premises update mentions earlier work on fraud prevention headers. The configurable behavior is documented in 14.25.

feature: Spain — Improve handling of multiple SII special scheme codes
description: Improves Spanish SII processing for documents that use multiple special scheme codes, supporting more accurate reporting of the applicable tax schemes.

feature: W1 — Configure the Intrastat checklist
description: Makes the Intrastat checklist configurable in the W1 application, allowing organizations to tailor the checklist used to prepare Intrastat reporting.

feature: Italy — Update Certificazione Unica reporting
description: Updates the Italian Certificazione Unica functionality to align Business Central reporting with the applicable annual tax certificate requirements.

feature: Spain — Report VAT cash refunds through SII
description: Adds support for reporting VAT cash refunds through Spain’s SII functionality, so refund information can be included in the electronic VAT reporting flow.

feature: Dimension issues detection and repair tool
description: Detects incorrect shortcut dimension numbers in dimension-set entries, such as values introduced by imports without validation, and helps repair problems that affect reports and page values.

feature: Integration of Word templates
description: Lets users add Word templates to interactions and log the resulting interactions to a segmented audience, using Business Central as the mail-merge data source.

feature: Data administration and cleanup tasks page
description: Brings administrative options for managing table and database size into one page and provides in-product guidance for cleanup tasks.

feature: Get report (raw data) into Excel from request page
description: Adds a data-only Excel output on the report request page, exporting the report dataset without applying its presentation layout.

feature: Export any list part to Excel
description: Extends Excel export to supported list parts so users can take visible list data into a workbook for further analysis.

feature: Upgrade to certificate-based Service-to-service (S2S) authentication for Dataverse and Dynamics 365 Integration
description: Supports moving Business Central online integrations with Dataverse from client-secret-based service authentication to certificate-based authentication.

feature: Service-to-service authentication
description: External applications can authenticate to Business Central APIs and web services using the OAuth client credentials flow. Register the application in Microsoft Entra ID, grant and consent to application permissions, and assign Business Central permission sets. Online support for standard and custom APIs and web services starts in 18.3. On-premises support starts in 18.11 and 19.5 and requires Microsoft Entra authentication with OpenID Connect.

feature: Integration of Word templates with interaction templates
description: Word templates are a great way to speed up and ensure high-quality, in-bulk communication with your customers and business partners. Now, you can use Word templates when you log interactions with the new interaction templates. In 2021 release wave 1, we added Word templates so you can use Business Central as the data source for mail merge documents in Word. With the July update, users will be able to add a Word template to interactions, and then log the interactions to a segmented audience.

feature: New countries/regions added to the list of supported countries/regions
description: Expands the countries and regions recognized by Business Central's supported-country and translation information, helping admins and partners identify localization and language coverage.

feature: Business Central Database capacity changes (as of July 1, 2021)
description: Updates the database capacity entitlement information for Business Central tenants effective July 1, 2021, clarifying the storage capacity included with the service and how additional capacity is handled.

feature: Great Britain — Send Making Tax Digital fraud prevention headers automatically
description: Sends the required Making Tax Digital fraud prevention headers automatically for UK VAT submissions, removing the need for users to provide those values manually. Microsoft documents the on-premises change in 14.27 and lists it again in update 18.4.

feature: Norway — Improve SAF-T reporting
description: Updates Norway’s SAF-T export to improve the audit file output for Norwegian reporting requirements.

feature: Extension validation on upgrade
description: Validates per-tenant extensions before an upgrade, checking dependencies, compilation, breaking schema changes, and duplicate object IDs so upgrades can proceed only after validation succeeds.

feature: Additional columns through personalization
description: Makes more fields available for users to add to pages through personalization, allowing each role to see additional relevant information without an extension.

feature: Non-inventory items in requisition and planning worksheets
description: Uniforma l approvvigionamento di articoli inventariabili e non inventariabili.

feature: Bank and payment reconciliation improvements
description: Adds preview posting and improves matching and filtering in bank and payment reconciliations, helping users review proposed entries and resolve unmatched transactions.

feature: Excel actions moved to Share menu
description: Moves Open in Excel and Edit in Excel to the Share menu, making those actions easier to find on Business Central pages.

feature: Copy environment to sandbox
description: Improves the process for copying a Business Central environment to a sandbox, making it easier to create a test environment based on production data and configuration.

feature: Bulk couple Business Central and Dataverse records
description: Lets users pair and synchronize multiple Business Central and Dataverse records in a batch, reducing manual work when establishing links between integrated records.

feature: Snapshot debugger performance metrics
description: Adds execution metrics and additional details to snapshot debugger replay, helping developers identify performance issues while analyzing recorded AL sessions.

feature: Control access to AL extension source with resource exposure policies
description: The resourceExposurePolicy setting in app.json lets extension publishers independently control whether other developers can debug the extension, download its source, or see its source in symbol packages. It supersedes the showMyCode setting.

feature: Force schema synchronization for per-tenant extensions online
description: Authorized administrators can deploy a per-tenant extension with force schema synchronization when an update must remove tables or fields. Removing those objects also removes their stored data, so Microsoft recommends testing the deployment in an equivalent environment.

feature: Specify locations for non-inventory items
description: Users can enter locations for non-inventory and service items in supported transactions. Business Central carries the location to the resulting entries so users can report on transactions associated with each location.

feature: Group G/L and VAT entries in posting preview
description: Extended posting preview can show general ledger and VAT entries in a hierarchical view before posting. Developers can extend the preview to present additional types of entries.

feature: Set quantity rounding precision for the base unit of measure
description: Define how quantities round in an item’s base unit of measure. This reduces precision errors when a quantity entered in another unit is converted to the base unit.

feature: Filter currency exchange rate adjustments by account
description: Run the Adjust Exchange Rates batch job for selected customer, vendor, or bank accounts. The account type and record filters let accountants revalue only the balances they need to adjust.

feature: Use AL to view and share files in OneDrive
description: AL objects let extensions copy a Business Central file to OneDrive for Business and open it in the browser for viewing or sharing. Office formats open in the applicable web application, and other formats use the OneDrive viewer.

feature: Search Business Central documentation from the Help pane
description: Users can search Microsoft Business Central documentation directly in the Help pane while staying on the current page. Search results help them find guidance related to the task at hand.

feature: Find and correct posting setup and dimension errors
description: The Error Messages page can show the source and field responsible for a posting setup or dimension error. Users with the appropriate permissions can follow the link to the relevant setup and correct it.

feature: Share Business Central record to Teams
description: Share a link to the current Business Central record from the web client in a Microsoft Teams chat or channel. Recipients can open the link if they have access to the record.

feature: Copying environments of different types
description: Extends environment copying to production-to-production, sandbox-to-sandbox, and sandbox-to-production scenarios, giving administrators more flexibility for implementation, testing, and maintenance.

feature: Operations log enhancements
description: Expands the Business Central admin center operations log with additional environment and app-management events, giving administrators a broader view of administrative activity.

feature: Restart environments
description: Adds an action on the admin center Manage sessions page to restart a Business Central environment as a troubleshooting step.

feature: Support for 2D barcodes
description: Provides fonts for two-dimensional barcodes in online production and sandbox environments and an AL module that helps developers encode supported barcode symbologies.

feature: Shipping agent information is copied from sales orders to warehouse shipments
description: Copies the external document number, shipping agent code, and shipping agent service code from a sales order when a warehouse shipment is created from it.

feature: United States — Apply the December 2021 Form 1099 format changes
description: The United States localization supports the December 2021 changes to Form 1099 reporting for vendor payments. Users identify 1099-liable purchases and specify the applicable 1099 code for the vendor.

feature: AL compiler diagnostic messages includes URLs
description: Adds links from AL compiler and analyzer diagnostic messages to documentation about the issue and possible ways to resolve it.

feature: Use two-dimensional barcodes in reports (Business Central online)
description: Customers can now add two-dimensional barcodes to reports. This release wave adds fonts to generate two-dimensional barcodes in Business Central production and sandbox environments. This means that any custom layouts using the fonts will work. We have licensed the font packages provided by IDAutomation Inc. We also have added a new AL module to make it easy for developers to encode strings in the different barcode symbologies that the fonts support.

feature: Synchronize multiline text fields between Business Central and Dataverse (and Dynamics 365 Sales)
description: Synchronizes multiline text fields between Business Central and Dataverse, including Dynamics 365 Sales, so longer notes and descriptions can flow between connected records.

feature: Norway — Submit the new electronic VAT return
description: The Norwegian localization supports the new electronic VAT return submission. Before submitting returns, an administrator configures the connection to the Norwegian authentication service and authorizes Business Central to submit on behalf of the company.

feature: Mexico — Support CFDI Carta de Porte 2.0 for packing slips and transfer orders
description: Mexican businesses can generate signed CFDI packing slips and transfer orders with the Carta de Porte 2.0 complement. Microsoft listed the feature in 19.2 and clarified in 19.3 that the requirement applies from January 1, 2022. The current functional guide describes the later 3.1 format.

feature: EU countries/regions — Add 2022 Intrastat reporting data
description: Updates Intrastat exports for 2022 requirements by including Partner VAT number and country or region of origin for applicable transactions, adjusting Nature of Transaction data, and using the file format required by each reporting country.

feature: Germany — Use XML instead of ASCII for Intrastat files
description: Retires the obsolete ASCII export format for German Intrastat reporting and uses XML as the supported file format.

feature: Norway — Extend the electronic VAT return workflow
description: Extends Norway’s electronic VAT return with VAT codes and related VAT specification and VAT note entities, multiple stored submission and response files, and numeric-only VAT registration numbers in submitted data.

feature: Allow Delegated Admin to setup and run Cloud Migration with approval from a licensed user
description: Allows a delegated administrator to prepare and run a cloud migration after a licensed Business Central user approves the requested operation, supporting partner-led migration while retaining customer authorization.

feature: Norway — Correct bank data in SAF-T exports
description: Corrects bank data exported in Norwegian SAF-T files to comply with the BankAccountStructure requirements.

feature: India — Preview posting for service transfer orders
description: Adds Preview Posting to Indian service transfer orders so users can review the entries that will be created before they post the document.

feature: Blocking deletion of G/L accounts
description: Blocking deletion of G/L accounts.

feature: Auto-accept transactions for intercompany journals
description: Auto-accept transactions for intercompany journals.

feature: Payment reconciliation journal - Preview Posting enabled
description: Payment reconciliation journal - Preview Posting enabled.

feature: Allow sell-to and bill-to customers to be different for jobs
description: Allow sell-to and bill-to customers to be different for jobs.

feature: Bank Account Statement report
description: Bank Account Statement report.

feature: Block VAT and General Posting Setups
description: Block VAT and General Posting Setups.

feature: Change default company bank account on sales and service documents
description: Change default company bank account on sales and service documents.

feature: Check documents and journals while you work
description: Check documents and journals while you work.

feature: Consolidate customer and vendor balances
description: Consolidate customer and vendor balances.

feature: Finding documents and entries efficiently
description: Finding documents and entries efficiently.

feature: Fixed Quantity in production bills of materials
description: Fixed Quantity in production bills of materials.

feature: Set default dimensions on locations
description: Set default dimensions on a location card. When a document line specifies that location, Business Central copies its dimensions to the line. Users can adjust the copied values, subject to any posting requirements.

feature: Copy link from the Share menu
description: Use Copy Link in the Share menu to copy the URL for the current page or record. Users can paste it into another application and recipients can open it if they have permission.

feature: Export report datasets to XML
description: Users and developers can export a report’s raw dataset as XML directly from its request page. The file contains the data independently of the report layout.

feature: Profile performance from the Business Central client
description: Start and stop a profiling capture while performing a task in the web client. The results show time spent in extensions and their most expensive calls so users can investigate performance issues.

feature: Define multiple layouts of the same type in report objects
description: Use the rendering section of a report or report extension to include multiple layouts, including layouts of the same type. The rendering section replaces use of the older layout properties within the same object.

feature: Create and post bank deposits
description: Record all transactions that make up a bank deposit in one document and post them together. Posted deposit details remain available for reviewing individual transactions and reconciling the bank account.

feature: Show context-aware Microsoft and partner links in the Help pane
description: The Help pane can display links that relate to the page the user is working on. Microsoft and partners can supply guidance for the relevant page or process.

feature: Enter demand forecasts by item variant
description: The redesigned demand forecast interface supports the variant code, so planners can enter quantities for individual item variants instead of aggregating all demand under the item.

feature: Install the Business Central web app from Microsoft Store
description: The Business Central progressive web app is available in the Microsoft Store. It provides the web client experience in a desktop app window and updates with the web service.

feature: Use rich text and links in teaching tips and tours
description: Teaching tips can use rich text formatting and link to other in-app entities. This helps authors present clearer instructions and lead users to the next part of a process.

feature: Select reports for project quotes
description: Use Report Selection - Job to specify which reports print for job quotes. Administrators can replace the default Job Quote report or select more than one report for the document type.

feature: Design report layouts in Excel
description: Create and edit report layouts in Excel and save them to Business Central. Excel layouts can use workbook features such as charts and pivot tables to present report data.

feature: Customize account schedule report presentation
description: The account schedule enhancements give financial report designers more control over the presentation of user-defined financial reports, including how labels and report values are displayed.

feature: Add email attachments to records from the Outlook add-in
description: Use the Business Central Outlook add-in to attach files from an email to a Business Central record. Users can capture documents such as emailed supplier invoices while working in Outlook.

feature: Add action on card and list pages to trigger a chosen flow from Business Central web client
description: Adds an Automate action group to eligible pages so users can run an instant Power Automate flow for the current record, such as a customer or sales order.

feature: Power Platform and Azure Logic Apps connector for Business Central online no longer in preview
description: Makes the online connector generally available with improved reliability, filtering, sorting, and support for related records such as document headers and lines.

feature: Fraud prevention headers for clients in the UK
description: Adds the fraud-prevention headers required by HMRC to electronic VAT submissions for Making Tax Digital in the United Kingdom.

feature: Country/regional expansion in 20 new countries
description: Expands Business Central availability to 20 additional countries or regions, broadening the markets where customers can use the service and applicable local capabilities.

feature: Shopify Connector
description: Connect Shopify online stores with Business Central to synchronize products, inventory, customers, orders, fulfillments, transactions, and payouts. The connector was introduced for Business Central online in update 20.1; it became available to existing customers through Marketplace later in May 2022.

feature: Release and reopen multiple documents
description: Allows users to release or reopen multiple documents together and shows a confirmation indicating the selected documents and those left unchanged.

feature: Improved settings for managing updates
description: Improves Business Central online update scheduling with a default update window and the ability to specify an environment time zone.

feature: Support inventory pick and warehouse pick operations for jobs
description: Supports inventory and warehouse picks for job-related item consumption, adapting the process to the location's warehouse configuration.

feature: New AppSourceCop allowing you to run validation to determine any code hit by obsoleted objects for a given future version
description: Adds an AppSourceCop validation that identifies extension code affected by objects becoming obsolete in a specified future Business Central version, helping developers address compatibility before upgrading.

feature: Shopify prospects get a great first-run experience
description: Uses signup context to tailor the initial Business Central experience for Shopify prospects and help them explore onboarding without immediate partner assistance.

feature: Current user support for the SMTP email connector
description: Adds current-user support for SMTP email, allowing email setup and sending to use the signed-in user's identity and credentials where supported by the SMTP connector.

feature: Modern action bar
description: Introduces a reorganized action bar with a Home tab, split buttons, and additional personalization options, helping users find and tailor page actions more efficiently.

feature: Run app setup from Extension Management
description: Lets users launch an app’s setup from Extension Management, making it easier to configure newly installed extensions without searching for each setup page.

feature: Shopify connector improvements
description: Improves the Shopify connector interface, synchronization, and connection management so users can manage shop integration tasks more efficiently from Business Central.

feature: Excel reporting improvements
description: Espande l uso di Excel come layout e strumento di reporting.

feature: Improved Microsoft 365 collaboration
description: Improves collaboration between Business Central and Microsoft 365 applications, including Teams, Outlook, and Excel, helping users work with business data in their existing productivity tools.

feature: Inherit ApplicationArea from the page for page fields
description: Page fields default to the ApplicationArea of their containing page when the property is omitted. Developers can still specify a different ApplicationArea on a field when necessary.

feature: View the length of Text and Code fields in page inspection
description: Page inspection shows the maximum length of Text and Code fields in the table fields list. Users can check the field size while troubleshooting without opening the table source.

feature: Switch companies across environments
description: The company switcher lets users open a company in another Business Central environment they can access. This reduces the need to track separate URLs for each company.

feature: Launch an AL session in a specific company from Visual Studio Code
description: Set the startupCompany property in an AL launch configuration so Business Central opens directly in the intended company when running or debugging an extension.

feature: Exclude Try functions when breaking on errors in the AL debugger
description: Set the debugger’s breakOnError option to ExcludeTry to avoid stopping on errors handled by Try functions while continuing to break on other errors.

feature: Financial reporting replaces account schedules
description: The Financial Reports page replaces the Account Schedules experience. Report designers configure a report from reusable row and column definitions, and existing account schedules remain available through the renamed experience.

feature: Use VAT Date on documents and entries
description: A separate VAT Date on documents and entries lets companies report VAT in the appropriate period independently of the posting date. Business Central carries the date to VAT entries for reporting.

feature: Transfer data in bulk in AL upgrade code
description: The DataTransfer AL type moves data between SQL-backed tables as sets. This can speed up data migrations in supported upgrade or install code. Row-level triggers and events do not run for these bulk operations.

feature: Use symbolic option access syntax in AL formulas
description: AL formulas can reference supported options symbolically, such as using Database::Customer in a TableRelation or CalcFormula expression. This makes references clearer than numeric object identifiers.

feature: Skip temporary records when breaking on writes in the AL debugger
description: Use ExcludeTemporary for the breakOnRecordWrite debugger setting so writes to temporary records do not interrupt the debugging session.

feature: See primary key field order in AL IntelliSense
description: IntelliSense marks primary key fields with a numbered PK indicator. The number shows the position in the key and helps developers use fields in the required order.

feature: See primary key field order in AL record tooltips
description: The Record tooltip identifies primary key fields with numbered indicators rather than an unnumbered mark. Developers can see the exact key order without opening the table definition.

feature: Generate or update AL permission sets from Visual Studio Code
description: The AL command generates or updates permission-set source for the current project. Developers can use it to include relevant objects in a permission set during development.

feature: Enable NoImplicitWith by default for new AL projects
description: New AL projects enable NoImplicitWith by default. Developers explicitly qualify references that would otherwise rely on an implicit with scope.

feature: Configure OneDrive integration with assisted setup
description: The Connect your files to the cloud assisted setup lets administrators configure how Business Central uses OneDrive for Business for opening and sharing files.

feature: Choose the report layout on the request page
description: When running a report, users can choose a layout on its request page. This allows a layout to be selected for an individual run without changing the default report layout.

feature: Require a variant code for items with variants
description: Turn on Variant Mandatory if Exists to require users to specify a variant for an item that has variants. This helps prevent transactions that omit the information needed to distinguish variants.

feature: Open app setup at the end of installation
description: When installing an app, users can wait in the installation guide for the process to finish. If the app provides a setup page, the guide can open it immediately after installation.

feature: Read the database row version from AL
description: AL can read the SystemRowVersion field to determine a record’s database row version. Extensions can use the value to recognize changes since an earlier read.

feature: Personalize and design Automate actions in the web client
description: The Automate action group supports personalization and AL design. Developers can define custom actions and users can organize the available automation actions in the client.

feature: Show or hide Power BI parts on lists using personalization
description: The visibility of Power BI report parts on list pages is controlled through personalization of the FactBox. This replaces the separate Show/Hide Power BI Reports action.

feature: Show executed lines during snapshot debugging playback
description: Snapshot playback marks executed AL source lines in the editor gutter. Developers can see which code paths ran and decide where additional snappoints would help diagnose a problem.

feature: Sort records flexibly in the Planning Worksheet
description: Users can sort lines in the Planning Worksheet to put relevant planning suggestions together and review them in the order that suits their workflow.

feature: Allow source access by default in the AL:Go! project template
description: Projects generated with AL:Go! set the resource exposure policy to allow debugging, source download, and source inclusion in symbols by default. Publishers can change the policy for the extension.

feature: Access Business Central with your Microsoft 365 license
description: Allows eligible Microsoft 365 users without a Business Central license to read permitted Business Central data in a simplified Teams interface; this access does not grant rights to create, edit, or delete records.

feature: Embed Business Central in Teams tabs
description: Lets users pin a Business Central card or add a Teams tab containing a Business Central page or record, making relevant business data accessible within a chat or channel.

feature: Auto-Save as you work:
description: Saves individual field changes when the user moves focus away instead of waiting for the page to close. Microsoft notes that administrators may need to enable the feature in Feature Management.

feature: Accessibility declaration for Italy available
description: Adds an Italian accessibility declaration link to the help pane when the web client uses Italian and provides a corresponding link in the mobile app listing.

feature: Use SharePoint Connector module in System Application to build integration between Business Central and Sharepoint
description: Provides an AL module for connecting and authenticating to SharePoint and performing basic operations on files, folders, lists, list items, and attachments through SharePoint REST APIs.

feature: Use multiline text fields with Word mail merge
description: Preserves line breaks from multiline fields when Business Central data is merged into Word templates used to generate communications.

feature: Sync users based on environments security group
description: Limits the Update Users from Microsoft 365 action to licensed users in the security group assigned to the Business Central environment.

feature: Business Central is available in 11 more countries/regions
description: Extends Business Central service availability to 11 additional countries or regions, broadening the geographic coverage for online customers.

feature: Use default attachments in email sent from Business Central
description: Lets administrators assign files to email scenarios and mark them as default attachments so relevant files can be included when messages are composed.

feature: Easily comply with email sending limits through email throttling
description: Lets administrators configure a per-minute sending limit for an email account, helping outgoing messages respect provider rate limits.

feature: Move custom fields to extensions during cloud migration
description: Uses migration table mapping to move selected fields from an on-premises source table to a different online table or table extension during cloud migration.

feature: Integrated session using Service-to-Service (S2S) authentication can now schedule tasks
description: Allows supported integrated sessions authenticated with service-to-service credentials to schedule tasks without an interactive user.

feature: Media/image support for Business Central connectors
description: Enables Power Platform and Logic Apps connector scenarios that read or manipulate media such as item or customer images from Business Central online.

feature: Power Apps and Power Automate support for document attachments
description: Enables connector-based apps and flows to work with attachments and related record media, such as a PDF linked to a sales order or a picture linked to an item.

feature: Reverse payment reconciliation journal entries
description: Improves payment reconciliation workflows by supporting reversal of journal entries and helping users identify and avoid already posted entries.

feature: Access attachments on additional list pages
description: Adds the Attachments FactBox to additional list pages, including fixed assets, employees, items, resources, vendors, and selected posted documents.

feature: Scroll through more records in lists
description: Reduces the memory footprint of loaded records so users can scroll through more rows on lists and worksheets, subject to the available client resources.
