feature: Reuse launch configurations across workspace projects
description: Lets AL developers define launch configurations at the workspace level and reuse them across projects, reducing duplicated configuration and keeping environment targets consistent.

feature: Copying the SystemID and data audit fields using CopyRows
description: Adds support for copying SystemId and data audit fields when transferring rows with the AL DataTransfer CopyRows operation.

feature: Get more, better communications as admin
description: Administrators receive clearer notifications in the Microsoft 365 Message center and by email. Additional notices can cover an extension affecting performance, the use of deprecated functionality, or events that require action.

feature: Get more visibility into service interruptions
description: When a declared incident affects an environment, users can see incident details if sign-in fails. Administrators can see a corresponding service interruption notice in the Business Central administration center.

feature: Restore deleted environments
description: Administrators can recover a soft-deleted online environment from the Business Central admin center for up to seven days after deletion. This includes eligible deleted trial environments. Microsoft deployed the service capability independently of the 21.4 application update.

feature: Use advanced settings when restoring an environment to a point in time
description: When restoring an environment, administrators can optionally uninstall per-tenant extensions or AppSource apps that prevent the restore and can skip the standard cleanup. Uninstalling apps during a restore retains their data.

feature: Restrict traffic on system integrations with service tags
description: Administrators can use the Dynamics365BusinessCentral Azure service tag in firewall or network security group rules to control traffic to or from Business Central. Azure maintains the addresses, and the tag represents the service globally rather than a particular tenant or environment.

feature: Copy SystemId and data audit fields with DataTransfer.CopyRows
description: In AL upgrade code, DataTransfer.CopyRows can copy SystemId and data audit fields when you explicitly map them with AddFieldValue. This preserves record identity and audit metadata during bulk upgrades.

feature: Get started with more sample Power Automate templates and Power Apps
description: Get started with more sample Power Automate templates and Power Apps.

feature: Use business events to notify and trigger external systems
description: Use business events to notify and trigger external systems.

feature: Select Dataverse environment for Power Automate flow actions
description: Select Dataverse environment for Power Automate flow actions.

feature: Post adaptive card or link to Business Central record with Power Automate
description: Post adaptive card or link to Business Central record with Power Automate.

feature: New approval workflow experience with Power Automate templates
description: New approval workflow experience with Power Automate templates.

feature: Preview the effect of exchange rate adjustments
description: Preview the effect of exchange rate adjustments.

feature: Alternative customer/vendor posting groups
description: Alternative customer/vendor posting groups.

feature: Analyze, group, and pivot data on list pages
description: Analysis mode lets users analyze data directly on supported list pages. They can group and pivot data, apply filters, and save separate layouts as tabs. Microsoft first offered the feature in public preview for 22.0 and made it generally available in the following release wave.

feature: Review general ledger accounts faster
description: The Review Entries action lets accountants mark transactions on selected G/L accounts as reviewed and see the review status when reconciling or checking account activity.

feature: Personalize actions on document line parts
description: Users can personalize the action bar on document lines. Frequently used actions can be brought into view on the subpage so they are easier to reach during document entry.

feature: Set a title and custom actions on AL error dialogs
description: AL developers can add a title and custom actions to an ErrorInfo dialog. The actions can help users open the relevant record or resolve the problem described in the error.

feature: Synchronize master data across companies
description: Choose a source company and synchronize selected master data to other companies in the same environment. Administrators specify which tables and fields to synchronize and can schedule regular updates.

feature: Manage Business Central permissions with security groups
description: Assign Business Central permissions to security groups so users receive role-based access through their group membership. This streamlines managing the same permissions for multiple users.

feature: Navigate actions and menus using keyboard KeyTips
description: Display keyboard KeyTips for menus and actions in the client. Users can press the indicated keys to navigate and run actions without using a mouse.

feature: Drag and drop a file onto the file upload dialog
description: Drop a file onto the Business Central upload dialog to select it for upload. The existing file picker remains available.

feature: Filter the content of created inventory warehouse documents
description: Filter source records when running Create Inventory Put-away, Pick, or Movement. This lets warehouse users control which eligible lines are included in the documents created by the batch job.

feature: Ship and receive non-inventory items on warehouse documents
description: When configured, non-inventory lines can be posted with warehouse receipts and shipments. This keeps those lines together with the related inventory shipment or receipt.

feature: Apply default location dimensions to inventory documents and journals
description: Default dimensions on a location can also flow to inventory documents and journals. This extends location-based dimension defaults to additional entries created by inventory processes.

feature: Select multiple items and identify required fields in transfer orders
description: Transfer orders support adding multiple items from the item list in one action, and the page identifies required fields. These changes reduce repetitive entry when preparing a transfer.

feature: Undo transfer shipments
description: Undo an eligible posted transfer shipment to correct a shipping error. Business Central creates corrective entries so the transfer can be corrected before it is processed again.

feature: Post multiple transfer orders at the same time
description: Select multiple transfer orders and post them in a batch. This reduces the need to open and post orders individually.

feature: Use item number series for catalog items and add them to blanket orders
description: Catalog items can use standard item number series when converted to regular items. Catalog items can also be added to blanket sales orders.

feature: Set record read isolation in AL
description: The ReadIsolation property lets AL developers choose the isolation level for reads on a record instance. This provides more control over read consistency and locking within a transaction.

feature: Preview posting for journals and documents
description: Preview posting shows the expected entries for item journals and additional journals and documents before posting. This lets users inspect the effects and correct data before creating ledger entries.

feature: AL Explorer and AL Home in Visual Studio Code
description: AL Explorer helps developers find AL objects, dependencies, events, and extension points in Visual Studio Code. The AL Home startup page gives extension users access to product news and learning resources.

feature: Allow application and tenant databases to differ in collation
description: A multitenant on-premises installation can serve tenant databases with SQL collations different from the application database. This lets tenants with different text sorting and comparison requirements share one Business Central Server instance.

feature: Turn off event-based sync for specific integration table mappings
description: Lets administrators enable or disable automatic event-driven synchronization for individual Dataverse integration table mappings, reducing synchronization load when many coupled records change frequently.

feature: Save time with automatic account codes
description: Uses customized posting groups to automate recurring journal, sales, or purchase postings and allocations across accounts or dimensions.

feature: Swedish localization delivered as extension
description: Delivers the Swedish localization as an extension and provides a data upgrade path from the previous localization.

feature: Attach AL debugger to active session or next session
description: Lets developers attach the AL debugger to a running session or the next session for a specified user using launch configuration identifiers and appropriate permissions.

feature: Non-deductible, partly deductible VAT expands functionality
description: Supports configuring and calculating fully or partially non-deductible VAT on purchases, including percentage-based deductions and related G/L posting setup.

feature: Partners can control welcome banner texts
description: Lets partners tailor the welcome banner and call to action shown when a user first signs in to a new company.

feature: Measure onboarding time of customers, apps and features
description: Emits onboarding telemetry based on business-process activity so partners can assess customer progress and provide assistance when onboarding stalls.

feature: Get unblocked using actionable error messages in select application areas
description: Improves error explanations and provides actions or links that help users navigate to the setup needed to resolve common problems.

feature: Synchronize returns, refunds from Shopify
description: Imports returns and refunds recorded in Shopify into Business Central as part of order synchronization.

feature: Additional types of document approval templates for Power Automate
description: Adds support for selecting approval workflow templates for more document types, helping Business Central online users configure Power Automate approvals.

feature: Connect to Dataverse when Business Central local currency is different from Dataverse base transaction currency
description: Permits a Dataverse connection when its base currency differs from the Business Central local currency, provided the Dataverse currency is configured in Business Central with an exchange rate.

feature: Use attachments from document lines while sending emails
description: Lets users add files attached to document lines to an email through the source document attachment selection in the email editor.

feature: Added new documentation, guidance, tools and samples illustrating a process of creating Power Apps for Business Central
description: Provides Microsoft guidance, tools, and samples for creating Power Apps that work with Business Central, helping makers connect app experiences to Business Central data and workflows.

feature: Business Central is enabled in 31 new countries and regions
description: More countries and regions are added to bring Business Central to approximately 130 countries and regions. We're expanding to more countries/regions through partner-led localization. Our partners create the relevant localization apps and publish them to AppSource. In combination with the built-in language offerings, we are making Business Central online available to serve customers in 130-plus countries and regions worldwide. In this release, we are planning to expand Business Central to the following countries and regions: - Andorra - Armenia - Azerbaijan - Bahamas - Bermuda - Bolivia - British Virgin Islands - Cambodia - Cameroon - Cayman Islands - Ethiopia - Fiji - Ghana - Guernsey - Isle of Man - Jersey...

feature: W1 — Provide SAF-T through the Audit File Export extension
description: Moves SAF-T functionality into the W1 application and provides a generic audit file framework through the Audit File Export extension, making the capability available for supported localizations.

feature: Denmark — Export G/L entries for Regnskab Basis
description: Exports general ledger details based on a standard chart of accounts to a CSV file ready for upload to Denmark’s Regnskab Basis system.

feature: Spain — Manually accept SII documents with inconsistent portal responses
description: Lets users manually mark an SII document as accepted when the AEAT portal has accepted it but returned an error. Business Central records the distinct Manually Accepted status to identify documents handled this way.

feature: Iceland — Update Sales & Receivables printing regulatory information
description: Updates the Printing FastTab on Sales & Receivables Setup with the correct product name and regulation number for Icelandic regulatory requirements.

feature: Users with the device license can now set up jobs to run as scheduled tasks in the job queue of Business Central
description: Allows a device-licensed user to configure supported job queue tasks to run on a schedule, enabling unattended recurring processing within the boundaries of device-user licensing.

feature: Copy Links when posting general journals
description: Copies links associated with general journal lines to the resulting posted general ledger entries, preserving access to supporting documents and related records after posting.

feature: Get control over how to view Power BI embedded content
description: Get control over how to view Power BI embedded content.

feature: Consolidated Power Automate flow creation from Business Central templates
description: Consolidated Power Automate flow creation from Business Central templates.

feature: Business Central virtual tables fully supported on Dataverse
description: Business Central virtual tables fully supported on Dataverse.

feature: Enable specific virtual tables when connecting to Dataverse
description: Enable specific virtual tables when connecting to Dataverse.

feature: Create Power Automate flows supporting different companies
description: Create Power Automate flows supporting different companies.

feature: Power Pages support via Business Central virtual tables
description: Power Pages support via Business Central virtual tables.

feature: Use synthetic relationships to expose more Business Central data in Dataverse
description: Use synthetic relationships to expose more Business Central data in Dataverse.

feature: Business events in Business Central connector for Power Automate
description: Business events in Business Central connector for Power Automate.

feature: Bank reconciliation with Copilot
description: Bank reconciliation with Copilot.

feature: Search data from anywhere in Business Central
description: Search data from anywhere in Business Central.

feature: SecretText data type
description: SecretText data type.

feature: Allocation account type
description: Allocation account type.

feature: Extend the currency exchange rate adjustment process
description: The redesigned exchange rate adjustment separates the processing codeunit from the request page, adds posting preview, and provides extensibility for local requirements. Extensions using legacy events must support the new implementation before the feature can be enabled.

feature: Receive more items than ordered with inventory put-away documents
description: In basic warehouses that handle receipts order by order, staff can record extra units on an inventory put-away when the assigned over-receipt code permits the quantity. Business Central tracks the excess and enforces the configured tolerance. Any adjustment to the vendor invoice is handled separately.

feature: Print and scan barcodes in Business Central
description: Business Central includes barcode support for common workflows, with standard printing and scanning capabilities for identifying records and transferring barcode values into the application.

feature: Store table extension fields in a single companion table
description: The server stores fields from all extensions of a table in one companion database table. A read that needs base and extension fields requires at most one join, even when multiple extensions add fields.

feature: Improve inventory count and adjustment workflows
description: Physical inventory orders can include items with no transactions at the chosen location. Item references help identify items on count orders and recordings. Inventory Setup can enable the quick Adjust Inventory action, which lets staff enter the actual quantity when concurrent postings change stock. Corrective inventory receipts and shipments can reverse quantities while retaining the original entry type.

feature: Find AL references to triggers, system methods and trigger events
description: The AL Find All References command supports triggers, system methods, and trigger events. Developers can locate uses of these symbols from the code editor.

feature: Configure handling for different warehouse operations
description: Configure warehouse handling to suit different business operations at a location. The settings let a location use the appropriate level of warehouse handling for the relevant process.

feature: Generate customer statements with open entries only
description: The customer statement report offers an Open Entries statement style. Use it to show outstanding entries without including fully applied transactions.

feature: Block item variants for sales and purchasing
description: Block a variant entirely or block it only for sales or purchasing. This allows transaction controls for individual variants while other variants of the item remain usable.

feature: Get IntelliSense for variables in the AL debugger console
description: The AL debugger console offers IntelliSense when adding variables to inspect. Developers can select available symbols while investigating state in a debugging session.

feature: Show AL method parameter and return type inlay hints
description: The AL editor can display inline hints for method parameter names and return types. These hints show relevant type and argument information while reading or editing calls.

feature: Delete orphaned data from uninstalled extensions
description: Administrators can use Delete Orphaned Extension Data to remove data left by an extension that is already uninstalled. This lets them clean up data that was retained during the original uninstall.

feature: Include intercompany general journals in approval workflows
description: Set up an approval workflow for intercompany general journals so entries can be reviewed and approved before posting.

feature: Choose more sampling intervals for AL profiling
description: Snapshot and in-client profiling offer additional sampling intervals. Developers can choose an interval suited to the duration and level of detail they need from a profiling capture.

feature: Navigate between orders, receipts, and invoices from quantity fields
description: Drill down from relevant shipped, received, or invoiced quantities to see the related documents. This makes it easier to trace fulfillment and invoicing from the original order.

feature: Set the default folder for new AL projects
description: Set the suggested folder for new projects created through AL:Go! so Visual Studio Code starts the project location prompt in the preferred directory.

feature: Share a data analysis view with a coworker
description: Copy a link from Analysis mode to share an analysis tab. A recipient with access to the source data can open the shared analysis definition in Business Central.

feature: Make intercompany transactions across Business Central environments
description: Set up an intercompany partner in another Business Central environment so companies can exchange supported intercompany documents or journals across environment boundaries.

feature: Demo tool and data for service scenarios
description: The Contoso Coffee demo extension generates service management setup and sample records to demonstrate repairs and service contracts. The walkthroughs require the Premium experience. On-premises installations receive the demo tool and data as source code on the product media.

feature: Mark fields as read-only when customizing UI
description: Users can lock editing for a field while personalizing a page, and administrators can apply the same setting to a profile. Users can undo their own locks. A field made read-only by the application or a profile administrator stays locked for the user. Use field locking to simplify data entry alongside existing permissions.

feature: Performance gain by reducing locks in the database
description: With tri-state locking, AL reads following a write to the same table normally use shared read-committed locks. This lets other sessions read and write concurrently when changes do not conflict. Explicit LockTable calls retain their original behavior. In version 23 on-premises, EnableTriStateLocking must be enabled in the server configuration.

feature: Suggest the next step for sales and production orders
description: The Reservation Worksheet allocates incoming stock in bulk to sales and production demand. Planners can group demand in worksheet batches, apply an allocation policy, and review the proposed quantities before committing reservations. A Reserved from stock indicator helps identify whether existing stock fully or partly covers the order.

feature: Use the AL Language extension for Linux in preview
description: The Visual Studio Code AL Language extension introduced a Linux variant for developing Business Central extensions. Developers install it from the Visual Studio Marketplace. The historical rollout described the Linux variant as a preview. The editor extension connects to an external Business Central environment when a local Windows-based server cannot run on the Linux host.

feature: Business Central virtual tables fully supported on Microsoft Dataverse
description: Exposes Business Central tables through Dataverse virtual tables so Power Platform apps and flows can work with Business Central data and relate it to native Dataverse tables.

feature: Power Pages support via Business Central virtual tables on Dataverse
description: Allows external Power Pages users to work with selected Business Central data through Dataverse virtual tables, with administrators controlling the permitted tables and operations.

feature: Include or exclude tables from cloud migration
description: Lets migration administrators select eligible tables to include or exclude when moving data to Business Central online, tailoring the scope to their requirements.

feature: Use actions to go to or fix errors inline
description: Inline field validation can offer actions that take users to the page where they can resolve an error or apply a correction when Business Central can determine one. For example, a general journal approver can open the approval comments or reject the approval to allow changes. Users can also revert the invalid edit or copy the technical details for troubleshooting.

feature: Get marketing text suggestions with Copilot
description: Save time and effort when bringing new products to market. Marketing text suggestions is now generally available. Business Central's first copilot feature, marketing text suggestions, moves from public preview to being generally available. - Start with a picture: Create a new item record by uploading a picture. Business Central analyzes the image and automatically suggests a matching category from your list of item categories. Customers who configured categories with templates and default attributes benefit from all of these being automatically assigned, reducing manual data entry. - Author marketing copy: The new Marketing Text page, reachable from the Item card actions or FactBox, is where users author a...

feature: Complete bank account reconciliation faster with Copilot
description: Bookkeepers in SMB organizations need to import bank statements and reconcile transactions with their bank ledger entries, making sure all transactions are accounted for. While Business Central already reduces effort through rule-based transaction matching, the residual work to process the unmatched transactions every week remains cumbersome and quickly accrues to lost workdays. Copilot reduces bookkeeping effort by matching more transactions and suggesting G/L accounts to post the remaining transactions. The bank account reconciliation feature in Business Central has been enhanced with: - AI-powered transaction matching that complements rule-based matching and further reduces the remaining unmatched...

feature: Extend G/L entry aggregations when posting invoices
description: Extensions can implement the Invoice Posting interface to control how general ledger entries are grouped when sales, purchase, or service invoices are posted. The extensible engine replaces the legacy Invoice Post. Buffer implementation. Microsoft documented a developer preview in October 2021, listed the feature again in the 22.5 notes, and confirmed general availability in 23.1.

feature: Spain — Add invoice counts and amounts to the Vendor - Overdue Payments report
description: The Spanish Vendor - Overdue Payments report (10748) includes monetary amounts and the count and share of paid invoices relative to total invoices, supporting statutory late-payment reporting. Microsoft also shipped the change on the 22.7 on-premises line.

feature: Spain — Use non-deductible and partly deductible VAT in SII reporting
description: The Spanish localization supports the global non-deductible VAT functionality for purchases with fully or partly non-deductible VAT, including VAT and SII reporting. Enable the feature in VAT Setup and configure the non-deductible percentage in VAT Posting Setup. Microsoft also shipped the change on the 22.7 on-premises line.

feature: Automatically update Marketplace apps with minor updates
description: Administrators can set an online environment to apply Marketplace app updates during minor as well as major Business Central updates. They can also schedule individual app updates for the next environment update window. The cadence applies to Marketplace apps.

feature: Show sales orders reserved from stock in a Role Center cue
description: A Role Center cue shows the number of sales orders reserved from stock so users can see the count at a glance. The article documents the cue in the standard 23.1 application on Business Central online.

feature: Improved data upgrade troubleshooting for Dynamics GP migration
description: Summarizes companies with upgrade failures and lets administrators drill into the record that caused a migration error.

feature: Easily integrate generative AI with your AL solutions
description: Provides Copilot development tools including the System.AI namespace and PromptDialog page type to connect AL solutions to Azure OpenAI and build consistent AI interactions.

feature: VAT posting in General Ledger setup
description: VAT Setup defines a company-wide permitted VAT date range independently of general ledger posting dates. User Setup can override that range for individual users. Business Central blocks documents and journals with a VAT date outside the permitted range. On upgrade, the new company settings inherit the existing general ledger posting date limits.

feature: New operational limits on scheduled tasks and web requests improve throughput
description: The new operational limits will improve protection, ensure fairness among users, and inspire elasticity and scalability of our service, while providing higher throughput for environments with many users. Business Central online handles diverse customer workloads with varying load patterns based on seasonality and many other factors, such as the number of active users, external integrations, BI and analytics tasks, and more. To manage these workloads efficiently, we've built a highly automated system that performs traffic management, load balancing and distribution, scheduled task execution, and capacity allocation based on the factors mentioned. We continuously improve the elasticity and scalability of our...

feature: Denmark — Submit VAT returns electronically
description: Submit Danish VAT returns directly to Skattestyrelsen through NemVirksomhed. The company must enter its CVR number in Company Information and authorize Business Central to submit on its behalf.

feature: Denmark — Upload and retain SAF-T files
description: Upload a SAF-T file and retain it as an attachment in Business Central to support Danish bookkeeping requirements.

feature: Denmark — Require digital vouchers when posting
description: Set rules by document or journal type so that posting requires an attached digital voucher. Denmark began enforcing the sales and purchase document requirement from July 1, 2024.

feature: Denmark — Notify companies to register with NemHandel
description: Business Central checks registration using the CVR number in Company Information. It prompts unregistered companies and links them to NemHandel registration. Notifications were scheduled to run by default from January 2024.

feature: Denmark — Block deletion of companies registered with NemHandel
description: Business Central blocks deletion of a Danish company registered with NemHandel in a production environment to preserve bookkeeping records. The restriction applies when the company registration and VAT registration details are set. The 27.1 update later introduced an exception for companies with no general ledger entries.

feature: E-invoicing with NemHandel in Denmark
description: Adds an e-invoicing app for Denmark that supports OIOUBL and PEPPOL formats and connects to NemHandel through certified access points.

feature: Detect invalid cloud migration configurations with proactive warnings
description: Warns administrators about potential migration issues such as unused table mappings or differences between source and destination record counts.

feature: Translatable Excel layouts
description: Allows Excel report layout authors to use translation tags for worksheet names, chart headers, pivot elements, slicers, and shared strings, which Business Central replaces when rendering.

feature: Make use of static and runtime metadata available in Excel layouts
description: Provides hidden worksheets containing report metadata, request options, filters, and captions so Excel layouts can use contextual information without requiring it in the report dataset.

feature: Generic Microsoft Graph API Wrapper
description: Provides an AL Microsoft Graph module for authorization and client initialization and for issuing supported Graph API requests.

feature: Add Azure File Services API module
description: Provides AL procedures using the Azure Files REST API to manage cloud file shares and related directories and files.

feature: Marketplace app hotfixes are now validated against the latest available app version
description: Validates a Marketplace app hotfix against the latest app version targeting the next Business Central release to help detect breaking changes.

feature: Marketplace ISV publishers can preview their Marketplace apps with select customers
description: Lets publishers provide a preview app link and code so selected customers can install and test an app in sandbox environments before general release.

feature: Improved update release processes
description: Improves the release and rollout process for Business Central updates, helping administrators understand and manage when environment updates are applied.

feature: Chat with Copilot
description: The legacy chat experience lets users ask natural-language questions to find Business Central data and get help with business tasks. Update 25.3 expanded its public preview to more countries and regions. Microsoft Copilot in Business Central replaces this legacy experience starting in version 29.

feature: Improved project invoicing
description: Supports invoicing work from multiple projects on a single customer invoice, helping project managers prepare billable project planning lines efficiently. This capability is distinct from assigning different bill-to and sell-to customers to individual project tasks.

feature: Archive and restore projects
description: Lets users archive project versions and restore a selected archived version when needed, preserving a project history and allowing work to resume.

feature: Assemble-to-project
description: Lets users add an assemble-to-order item from Project Planning Lines, linking assembly work to project demand and improving control of project-related inventory.

feature: Sustainability journals
description: Adds journal workflows for recording and tracking sustainability data, including emissions and other values used in sustainability reporting.

feature: Drag and drop multiple files
description: Lets users attach multiple files to Business Central records by dragging and dropping them into the client, reducing steps when adding supporting documents.

feature: Power BI dashboards for core ERP
description: Expands the built-in Power BI dashboards for core ERP processes, giving users ready-made analytical views of key Business Central data.

feature: Automate reminders and collections
description: Automates preparing, issuing, and sending customer reminders, with options to review and adjust reminder content before delivery. It helps collections teams manage overdue receivables and follow up consistently.

feature: Use the collection management Role Center
description: Adds a role center for collection management that brings together customer and posted-document information, overdue balances, reminders, statements, and related collection tasks.

feature: Control and monitor inventory cost adjustment
description: Adds a Cost Adjustment Log and an Inventory Cost Adjustment view to track adjustment runs, process filtered batches, and review errors. This helps identify delayed or inaccurate inventory costs and monitor their effect on the general ledger.

feature: Enter time sheets more productively
description: Improves time sheet entry with options to copy time sheets from previous periods, see more information on lines, use FactBoxes, and copy lines. The time sheet line list also supports analysis mode.

feature: Approve multiple time sheet lines
description: Adds a manager view for time sheet lines that supports reviewing and approving or rejecting selected lines together, reducing repetitive line-by-line approval work.

feature: Block items, variants, and service items in service transactions
description: Lets users block an item, item variant, or service item from being used in service contracts, service orders, and service invoices. This helps prevent selection of products that should no longer be used in service processes.

feature: Correct errors in service invoices
description: Adds correction options for service invoices posted for service contracts, helping users resolve posting mistakes and correct the related contract invoicing state.

feature: Set service invoice posting policies by user
description: Adds service invoice posting permissions and policies to User Setup so administrators can control which users can post service invoices and how service documents are posted.

feature: Attach documents to service records
description: Adds document attachments to service-related records, including service items, contracts, and invoices, so users can keep manuals, warranty certificates, inspection reports, and other supporting files with the relevant data.

feature: Use standard project management terminology
description: Updates application captions and documentation terminology from Jobs to Projects, making the project accounting area easier to understand while preserving compatibility with existing object and field names.

feature: Invoice project tasks to multiple customers
description: Lets users specify bill-to and sell-to customers for individual project tasks, so different parts of one project can be invoiced to the appropriate customers.

feature: Set a default location for a project or project task
description: Lets users set a default location on a project and use it for project tasks, planning lines, and journal lines, reducing repeated data entry and helping keep project transactions assigned to the intended location.

feature: Use Excel layouts for selected reports
description: Adds Excel report layouts to selected Finance, Sales, and Purchasing reports. Users can choose an Excel layout when running a report and analyze or present report data in Excel.

feature: Manage Field Service work orders and invoice them in Business Central
description: Adds an integration for importing and synchronizing work orders from Dynamics 365 Field Service as projects in Business Central, with mapping and setup pages to support the flow from service work to financial processing.

feature: Analyze telemetry events across browser, server, session, or user
description: Adds user and session identifiers to selected browser and client telemetry events, including page views, error message quality votes, and client-side actions. This makes it easier to correlate client-side activity with server telemetry when investigating a specific session or user.

feature: Improve approval processes through Power Automate
description: Improves Business Central approval integration with Power Automate, including access to Approval User Setup for flows and better ways to find a single Business Central record that meets specified criteria. This reduces duplicate approval-user setup and simplifies flow configuration.

feature: Define extension objects in the same app as their base objects
description: Lets developers define table, page, and other extension objects in the same app as the base object. This supports organizing related base and extended functionality together while allowing later separation into another app.

feature: Define field tooltips at the table level
description: Lets developers define a field tooltip on the table field so pages using that field can inherit the description, reducing repeated tooltip declarations across page objects.

feature: Debug the System Application
description: Enables developers to debug into the System Application while troubleshooting or developing extensions, helping them follow execution across their extension and Business Central application code.

feature: Default custom APIs to OData schema version 2.0
description: Custom API requests default to OData schema version 2.0, which serializes enum names in place of the captions used in version 1.0. Review integrations that depend on caption strings. Clients that support query parameters can explicitly request $schemaversion=1.0 for compatibility.

feature: Handle multiple file uploads
description: When AL developers handle multiple file uploads in Business Central, they add flexibility and usability. This enhancement benefits developers working on applications or customizations that require multiple-file upload functionality. It improves productivity and the user experience for organizations. Developers can handle multiple file uploads. With this improvement, AL developers can create more flexible and user-friendly interfaces within Business Central. When developers designate specific actions, users can upload multiple files at the same time, which improves efficiency. This feature is especially valuable for developers working on applications or customizations that require users to upload multiple...

feature: Use linked environment in Dataverse integration
description: Uses the Dataverse environment linked in the Business Central admin center to simplify and secure setup of integrations with Dataverse and related Dynamics 365 apps.

feature: Expand Copilot language availability
description: Update 24.2 expanded language availability for Analysis assist, Bank reconciliation assist, Marketing text suggestions, Sales lines suggestions, and E-documents matching. Microsoft cautioned that some languages were not fully supported and result quality could vary.

feature: Simplify collections with Copilot for Finance and Business Central (preview)
description: Integrates Business Central with Copilot for Finance to help collections teams work with customer receivables and improve collection workflows.

feature: Install Field Service Integration with Business Central from Marketplace
description: Adds an optional installation step for the Field Service Integration app in the Dynamics 365 Sales integration setup, avoiding disruption for customers who do not use Field Service.

feature: Enable additional countries and regions (general availability)
description: When you enable extra countries and regions, you get all the benefits of Business Central’s cloud-based business management software solution. Business Central expands to more countries and regions through partner-led localizations. Our partners create the relevant localization apps and publish them to AppSource. With the built-in language offerings, Business Central online serves customers in more than 170 countries and regions worldwide. This expansion enables the following countries and regions: - Belize - Burkina Faso - French Polynesia - Gabon - Gambia - Gibraltar - Laos - Mali - Marshall Islands - Moldova - Monserrat - Saint Kitts and Nevis - Saint Lucia - Saint Vincent and the Grenadines - Turks and...

feature: Automate country of origin listed for item tracking code in Intrastat reporting (general availability)
description: Intrastat reporting can use the country of origin carried from matching purchase documents to sales item tracking records. Configure this on the item tracking code so that lots or serial numbers can retain their origin when the same item is sourced from different countries. Microsoft listed the preview in 24.2 and 24.4 and confirmed general availability in 24.5.

feature: Enable sustainability features for integrations with APIs (general availability)
description: Sustainability APIs let external applications integrate with Business Central sustainability features. Microsoft listed the APIs in preview in 24.2, mentioned them in 24.3, and confirmed general availability in 24.5.

feature: Migrate record links and notes with cloud migration tooling (preview)

description: The Spanish localization adds a Closed flag for non-taxable entries. Users can filter the entries by status for VAT reporting and avoid carrying amounts that have already been accounted for into a later declaration.

feature: France — Add mandatory information to sales invoices
description: The French sales invoice includes the customer’s SIREN registration number, a delivery address when it differs from the billing address, the nature of the goods or services, and whether VAT is payable on debits. These additions address French tax authority requirements.

feature: End support for the OAuth password grant in Business Central online
description: Business Central online stops accepting the Resource Owner Password Credentials OAuth flow. Integrations that directly collect a user's password must move to a supported authentication flow such as authorization code with MSAL.

feature: Spain — Prevent duplicate SII submissions from concurrent job queues
description: An SII submission job reserves the documents it processes so another job cannot send the same set. This prevents duplicate-invoice errors caused by concurrent job queue entries when posting and sending documents in volume.

feature: Denmark — Use a Microsoft-managed certificate for electronic VAT drafts
description: Business Central online can use the supplied Microsoft certificate to send a draft VAT return to the Danish tax authority. The company must authorize the service at skat.dk and still review and submit the return there. On-premises administrators continue to configure their own certificates.

feature: Switch API change tracking from delta links to webhooks
description: Business Central removes server support for API delta links. Microsoft APIs no longer enable ChangeTrackingAllowed. Integrations that used delta links to retrieve changes should switch to webhook subscriptions and retrieve affected records after receiving a notification.

feature: Require a version 25 upgrade step before migrating or upgrading from version 14
description: Starting in version 26, the supported route from Business Central 14–24 to version 26 or later goes through version 25. This affects direct cloud migration and on-premises data upgrade because version 26 cleans up schema elements removed since version 14. Pre-14 installations first upgrade to version 14.

feature: Spain — Update the SII CSV format
description: The Spanish SII localization updates the CSV schema to comply with the latest requirements of the Spanish tax agency, AEAT. This changes the format used by the localized SII reporting workflow.

feature: Germany — Support the German Peppol BIS 3 e-invoice format
description: The E-Document framework supports the German variant of Peppol BIS 3. Users can select PEPPOL BIS 3.0 DE as the document format when configuring an E-Document Service for German e-invoicing.

feature: Belgium — Support the Belgian Peppol BIS 3 e-invoice format
description: The Belgian localization supports a Peppol BIS 3 format adapted to local e-invoicing rules, including use of the enterprise number. The country-specific format extends generic Peppol support for Belgian invoices.

feature: Include AL system symbols with Business Central Server
description: Business Central Server binaries now carry AL system symbols. Server administrators no longer publish a separate SymbolsOnly package with Publish-NAVApp, and can retrieve system package information by specifying the name System with Get-NAVAppInfo.

feature: Deprecation of the legacy Custom Report Layouts page
description: Business Central marks page 9650, Custom Report Layouts, as obsolete pending and directs administrators to the Report Layouts page. Use the Migrate to System Layouts action to bring legacy layouts to the supported layout experience.

feature: Germany — Update Intrastat XML for eSTATISTIK.CORE
description: The German Intrastat export generates XML that meets the latest eSTATISTIK.CORE requirements. The same update removes outdated validations associated with the IDEV submission channel. This is a later update to German XML reporting after the transition from ASCII.

feature: Switzerland — Import Swiss bank clearing numbers in CSV format
description: The Swiss localization can import version 3.0 of the bank clearing number file as CSV. The existing TXT format remains supported, and customers can import either format without additional setup.

feature: Spain — Use regional SII endpoints
description: The Spanish SII integration accepts tax authority endpoints for Navarra, Euskadi, and the Canary Islands. The update removes restrictions that previously required the hardcoded AEAT URL, so affected organizations can configure their regional service endpoint.

feature: Recent Record virtual table
description: The Recent Record virtual table (2000000174) lets AL code read the records recently accessed by the current user in the current company. Each entry identifies the table and record and stores when it was last used. Accessing a record again refreshes its timestamp. Extensions can delete history entries, while direct inserts and updates are unsupported.

feature: Removal of the legacy Custom Report Layouts page
description: The legacy Custom Report Layouts page is no longer accessible in Business Central 29. Use Report Layouts to manage user-defined layouts and migrate legacy layouts before upgrading.

feature: End support for administering Business Central with Windows PowerShell 5
description: Microsoft supports the Business Central server administration modules on PowerShell 7. The supported modules use the Microsoft.BusinessCentral prefix and are installed in the server Admin folder. Windows PowerShell 5 may still run some commands, but Microsoft no longer supports that configuration for on-premises or container administration.

feature: Remove the on-premises option to use data-defined permission sets only
description: Business Central removes the server option to set UsePermissionSetsFromExtensions to false. Installations that retained the legacy data-only permission-set configuration through version 28 must move to permission sets and entitlements defined in extension objects.

feature: Remove SOAP publishing for Microsoft UI pages
description: Version 29 removes the ability to publish Microsoft UI pages as SOAP web-service endpoints. Integrations that depend on those endpoints must change their service contract. Microsoft documents hosting a copy of the required page in an extension for integrations that still require page-based SOAP.

feature: Remove OData publishing for Microsoft UI pages
description: Microsoft plans to stop allowing pages defined in apps with Microsoft as the publisher to be published as OData endpoints in version 30.0. This affects integrations that use UI pages from the Base Application, System Application, or other first-party apps. Where a suitable API page exists, move the integration to that API. Microsoft also documents hosting a copy of the affected page in an extension for integrations that still require a page-based OData endpoint.

feature: Standardize activity groups in selected Role Centers
description: Adds common components such as headlines where missing, standardizes the Setup & Extensions group and Workflow entry, and shows Self-Service counts as cues or tiles.

feature: Remove the legacy Windows client
description: The old Dynamics NAV Windows client can no longer be deployed starting in Business Central 15. Existing users can switch to the browser, modern Windows app, or mobile app.

feature: Replace legacy user personalization and profile configuration
description: Legacy personalizations and profile configurations are discarded when moving to the AL-based tools. Users and administrators recreate their changes with the new tools, which retain them for subsequent releases.

feature: Remove the legacy Excel COM add-in
description: The Excel COM add-in shipped with the retired Windows client, so it is no longer available. To export Business Central data into an Excel workbook, use the Edit in Excel action.

feature: Remove Windows-client programmatic printing
description: Automatic printing without the end user choosing or confirming the operation depended on the legacy Windows client. That implementation is no longer available after the client is removed.

feature: Allow gaps in number series
description: The Allow Gaps in Nos. setting permits automatic or manual numbering without enforcing consecutive values. This can reduce contention on the number series line table and suits records where gaps are permitted.

feature: Deprecate ADAL and Azure AD Graph for Business Central integrations
description: Microsoft announced migration from the legacy directory library and API to MSAL and Microsoft Graph for identity integrations. From June 30, 2020, the older APIs stopped receiving new functionality while technical support and security updates continued under the announced timeline.

feature: Register work-center capacity in seconds
description: Work centers can use seconds as the capacity unit of measure. Developers can extend the available values when a production process requires finer precision.

feature: Configure advanced planning parameters in Essentials
description: The Essentials experience exposes advanced planning engine settings on the Manufacturing Setup page. Administrators can configure planning for several locations, simultaneous MPS/MRP calculation, and related defaults.

feature: Use read-only database access for frequently used reports
description: Makes read-only the default database access intent for selected reports. Where a read replica is available, report reads can reduce load on the writable database, with the possibility of a short replication delay.

feature: Disable legacy Integration Records generation
description: New tenants have Integration Records and Integration Management turned off by default. Existing or upgraded tenants can turn off generation through Feature Management after integrations have moved to system fields.

feature: Deprecate .NET Framework-based add-ins
description: Introduces a warning for add-ins compiled for .NET Framework rather than .NET Standard. Developers should migrate affected add-ins to .NET Standard before later removal of compatibility.

feature: Warn against exposing UI pages as SOAP endpoints
description: Adds a deprecation warning when pages are exposed through SOAP and recommends migrating integrations to OData V4. The warning precedes later restrictions on the page-based SOAP capability.

feature: Remove OData V3 support
description: Removes the deprecated OData V3 protocol version. Existing integrations should move to the supported OData V4 version.

feature: Remove the legacy on-premises Help Server component
description: The on-premises product media no longer includes Help Server. Customers upgrading from earlier versions that depend on it should move customized Help to another web host.

feature: Replace the Universal Windows Platform client with a progressive web app
description: Stops supporting the legacy Windows Store client for Business Central 19. Its replacement uses progressive web app technology. The previous client remains available for users on version 18 or earlier.

feature: Deprecate the Business Central Server Administration tool
description: Announces removal of the graphical server configuration tool for on-premises installations in a later release. Administrators should transition to the corresponding PowerShell cmdlets.

feature: Stop allowing StartSession in upgrade or install contexts
description: AL StartSession calls fail immediately inside an upgrade or installation context. Background sessions started this way could independently commit changes that the calling upgrade or installation could not roll back.

feature: Remove the beta version of standard APIs
description: Removes the beta version of the Business Central standard APIs. Existing integrations should move to the supported standard API v2.0 endpoints.

feature: Remove the beta version of Automation APIs
description: Removes the beta Automation API endpoints from new Business Central releases. Integrations should move to the supported Automation API v2.0 endpoints.

feature: Remove legacy Outlook data synchronization
description: Removes the older Outlook integration that synchronized data such as contacts, tasks, and to-dos. The separate Business Central add-in for working with business data in Outlook remains available.

feature: Deprecate nativeInvoicing APIs
description: Marks the nativeInvoicing API as deprecated for Business Central 2022 release wave 1. Move any affected integrations to supported standard Business Central APIs ahead of removal in version 23.

feature: Use multiple remit-to addresses for vendor check payments
description: You can record several remit-to addresses on a vendor card and choose the correct address for a purchase order or invoice. When a payment journal line uses that vendor ledger entry, it can inherit the remit-to code, which users can override before printing the check.

feature: Use statistical accounts in financial reports
description: Enter nonfinancial metrics such as headcount or floor area in a statistical accounts journal and include them in financial report row definitions. These figures are stored in a separate ledger and are excluded from the trial balance.

feature: Netherlands — Apply the vendor blocking flag to telebanking payments
description: The Dutch telebanking workflow now checks the blocking status of a vendor on CBG Statement Line. Payment processing therefore respects the blocking setting maintained on the vendor card.

feature: France — Use transaction numbers for invoice entries in the FEC export
description: The French accounting audit file report offers a Use Transaction No. option. Separate invoices posted together in a general journal can consequently have distinct, sequential EcritureNum values rather than sharing one general ledger register number.

feature: Denmark — Map general ledger accounts to the standard chart of accounts
description: Businesses can keep their operational chart of accounts and use the G/L Mapping page to link accounts to the Danish standard chart required for statutory reporting.

feature: Spain — Report invoice counts and amounts for overdue vendor balances
description: The Spanish Vendor - Overdue Balance report 10748 includes monetary volumes and invoice counts for the additional reporting requirements.

feature: United States — Use the updated IRS Form 1096 layout
description: Business Central updates the US IRS Form 1096 report layout and adds the new box required for the 2023 form.

feature: Switzerland — Use ciphers 303 and 383 on the VAT statement
description: The Swiss VAT statement includes ciphers 303 and 383 for reporting the updated rates applicable from 2024.

feature: Denmark — Lock the company CVR number after NemHandel validation
description: Once the company registration number entered on the Company Information page is validated with NemHandel, the Danish localization prevents the validated CVR number from being edited or deleted.

feature: Mexico — Support the Comercio Exterior 2.0 complement for CFDI 4.0
description: Business Central applies the Comercio Exterior 2.0 foreign-trade complement to CFDI 4.0, updating issuer and foreign-trade details and their validation to match the revised schema.

feature: Switzerland — Use the Swiss SEPA direct debit pain.008.001.02.ch03 format
description: The Swiss localization adds an XMLport for SEPA direct debit files that can be selected as a bank export or import format.

feature: Denmark — Include the Danish scheme ID in Peppol files
description: The Danish localization supplies SchemeID in the Peppol CompanyID element, uses 0184 for the Danish VAT scheme, and prefixes VAT registration numbers with DK where applicable.

feature: Italy — Include vendor exemption amounts in the Declaration of Intent export
description: The Italian Declaration of Intent Export card now populates Amount to declare with the amount for each vendor VAT exemption.

feature: Italy — Report vendors in deny-listed jurisdictions
description: The Italian localization adds an On Deny List flag to the country or region record and a Denied Vendors List report to help identify business with vendors in the specified jurisdictions.

feature: Mexico — Upgrade the Carta Porte complement to version 3.1
description: The Mexican localization updates Carta Porte from version 3.0 to 3.1 to accommodate revised requirements such as those covering customs regimes and hazardous materials.

feature: Schedule item cost adjustment and posting with assisted setup
description: An assisted setup guide creates the job queue entries needed to run item cost adjustment and posting in the background. Inventory Setup offers the guide after automatic cost posting is disabled or automatic cost adjustment is set to Never.

feature: Review inventory availability by lot
description: The Availability by Lot page shows inventory and demand or supply movements by lot. Documents such as purchase orders appear when item tracking has been assigned to their lines.

feature: Adjust stock using inventory receipts and shipments
description: Inventory Receipt and Inventory Shipment documents record stock increases or write-offs. Posted documents remain available for reprinting, with report selection and available layouts depending on the localization.

feature: Extend reports with the AL report extension object
description: The report extension object lets AL partners add dataset fields and request-page elements without taking ownership of the original report. An extension can supply its own layout while leaving the original layout intact.

feature: Add keys to existing tables through AL table extensions
description: Partners can use a table extension to add ordinary or SIFT indexes to improve performance for customer-specific data distributions.

feature: Find Business Central contacts directly in Microsoft Teams
description: The Business Central app for Teams adds a contact lookup to the search box and message compose area. Users can share a customer, vendor, or other contact as a card and open it to see contact information and related business details.

feature: Show bin and zone fields when warehouse bins are mandatory
description: Warehouse receipt and shipment pages, and relevant document lines, display the bin and zone fields only when the selected location requires bins. This reduces clutter for locations that do not use bin-based warehouse processes.

feature: Set invoice posting policies for sales and purchase users
description: User Setup controls whether each user can post an invoice separately, only post shipments or receipts, or must post the invoice together with shipment or receipt. This supports a separation of physical handling and financial posting.

feature: Enter opening balances for item-tracked inventory
description: Businesses migrating tracked inventory can enable serial, lot, and package fields on selected item journal batches. The feature also supplies an alternative suited to warehouse configurations, so users can capture tracking data with opening quantities.

feature: Configure exported Shopify prices and discounts
description: The Shopify setup lets users determine the exported sale price with a customer price group and specify a customer discount group, including when a discounted price and a comparison price are displayed. Without a price group, the item card supplies the base price.

feature: Manage intercompany posting setup from one page
description: The Intercompany Setup page brings partners, accounts, dimensions, and tasks together. Intercompany general journals can handle bank transactions and appear in G/L registers. Business Central online can validate setup across partner companies.

feature: Open warehouse documents directly from source records
description: Users can open records from additional lists using the clickable first column, Return, or Show Document. Links from source documents to warehouse picks and put-aways make it easier to trace warehouse activity.

feature: Improve navigation and layout on Financial Reporting pages
description: Financial Reports shows row and column analysis views. Users can hide options and dimensions to give the report more space, open row and column definitions directly, and edit report defaults from the report.

feature: Use selected advanced warehouse tools without directed put-away and pick
description: Locations can use functions such as zones, movement worksheets, bin replenishment, capacity and class checks, or special-equipment handling without enabling the entire directed put-away and pick workflow.

feature: Czechia — Release or reopen local documents in bulk
description: Users can release or reopen selected documents in Czech cash desk, compensation, and advance payment areas. The process reports progress and errors, and status colors help distinguish released documents from open ones.

feature: Czechia — Find local document lines with search
description: Business Central search opens individual line pages from Czech advance payments, bank statements and payment orders, cash documents, compensations, and other local areas. This provides direct access to both unposted and posted lines.

feature: Czechia — Print blanket purchase orders in the local layout
description: A new report prints blanket purchase orders using the Czech document layout. Buyers can communicate multiple expected receipts on one blanket order before converting individual lines into purchase orders.

feature: Czechia — Replace the local VAT date with VAT Reporting Date
description: The Czech localization adopts the shared VAT Reporting Date on sales and purchase documents and journals. The default can come from the document or posting date, and the chosen value flows to the posted VAT and G/L entries.

feature: Resolve creator and modifier names through system audit FlowFields
description: AL runtime 18.0 adds four read-only system FlowFields that resolve the creator and last modifier user IDs to user names or full names. The fields are SystemCreatedByUserName, SystemCreatedByFullName, SystemModifiedByUserName, and SystemModifiedByFullName. Extensions can read these values directly from the record instead of resolving the audit user IDs separately.

feature: Belgium — Use the 2019 Intrastat reporting format
description: Updates the Belgian Intrastat format for the 2019 reporting year. The change lets Belgian companies generate Intrastat declarations in the format required for that year.

feature: Netherlands — Use the 2019 VAT taxonomy for Digipoort
description: Updates Dutch electronic VAT reporting to use the 2019 taxonomy for submissions through Digipoort. The change aligns generated VAT submissions with the taxonomy for that reporting year.

feature: DACH — Print or export the VIES declaration with dedicated reports
description: Splits the VAT VIES declaration into two reports in the DACH localization. One report prints the declaration and the other exports it as XML.

feature: Russia — Support the 20% VAT rate in the VAT Ledger
description: Adds support for the 20% VAT rate in the Russian VAT Ledger and its reports.

feature: North America — Include substitution references in Mexico CFDI invoice XML
description: For posted invoices with CFDI relation type 04 (substitution of a previous CFDI), the Mexico Electronic Invoicing module in the North American application includes the folio and related CFDI information for the previous invoice and its credit memo in the exported XML.

feature: Norway — Print the KID number on sales documents
description: Includes the KID number when printing sales documents in the Norwegian localization. The printed payment reference helps recipients identify the transaction when making a payment.

feature: North America — Add CFDI relations to credit memos
description: Credit memos in the North American localization support CFDI relations, allowing the Mexico electronic invoicing workflow to associate a credit memo with a related CFDI document.

feature: Netherlands — Use the NT14 schema for electronic tax declarations
description: Updates the Dutch Electronic Tax Declaration report to use the NT14 schema for electronically submitted declarations.

feature: Italy — Distribute non-taxable amounts in withholding tax
description: The Italian localization can distribute the non-taxable amount when processing withholding tax.

feature: Netherlands — Use the NT15 schema for electronic tax declarations
description: Updates the Dutch Electronic Tax Declaration to use the NT15 schema for electronic tax submissions.

feature: Import label and presentation linkbases from newer XBRL taxonomies
description: Extends XBRL taxonomy import to support label and presentation linkbases from newer IFRS taxonomies. The linkbases supply labels and define the presentation structure of taxonomy concepts.

feature: Italy — Reuse the external document number across fiscal years
description: Allows the same external document number to be used in different fiscal years in the Italian localization.

feature: Belgium — Use version 9 of the Intervat declaration
description: Updates the Belgian Intervat declaration to version 9 for electronic VAT reporting.

feature: Belgium — Show vendor names in the EB Payment Journal
description: Shows the vendor name in a separate column in the Belgian EB Payment Journal, so users can identify the vendor directly on a payment line.

feature: North America — Track CFDI stamp cancellation with an electronic document status
description: Adds an electronic document status for canceling the CFDI stamp from a posted sales invoice in the Mexico electronic invoicing workflow of the North American localization.

feature: Switzerland — Run the DTA Payment Journal report from the payment journal
description: Makes the Swiss DTA Payment Journal report available directly in the payment journal.

feature: Norway — Improve EHF Billing 3.0 for finance charge memos and reminders
description: Updates the EHF Billing 3.0 format used for finance charge memos and payment reminders in the Norwegian localization.

feature: Norway — Improve SAF-T processing performance
description: Improves processing performance in the Norwegian Standard Audit File for Tax (SAF-T) functionality.

feature: Italy — Show Activity Code fields
description: Makes Activity Code fields visible to users in the Italian localization.

feature: Norway — Add free text to VAT return lines
description: The Norwegian electronic VAT return supports free text on individual lines. Users can include explanatory information for the specific VAT return line it relates to.

feature: Improve Sync-NavApp upgrades for environments with many companies
description: Improves the Sync-NavApp upgrade steps for environments with a very large number of companies.

feature: Improve telemetry for directory creation failures
description: Improves telemetry emitted when Business Central fails to create a directory, helping administrators diagnose these failures.

feature: Improve Sync-NavTenant upgrades for environments with many companies
description: Improves the Sync-NavTenant upgrade steps for deployments with a very large number of companies.

feature: Sync extensions with the CommitPerTable option in Sync-NavApp
description: Allows Sync-NavApp to commit schema synchronization per table. If the operation fails, restore the database from a backup before retrying.

feature: North America — Include zero-rate VAT details in CFDI invoice XML
description: The Mexico Electronic Invoicing module in the North American localization includes the VAT amount and percentage in CFDI invoice XML when the VAT rate is zero.

feature: North America — Preserve retention on copied corrective sales documents
description: The North American localization preserves retention when copied documents are used to cancel a sales document or to create a corrective sales credit memo.

feature: France — Improve Tax Audit job queue processing
description: Improves the performance of job queue management for Tax Audit in the French localization.

feature: Item - ABC Analysis report
description: Classifies inventory items by their contribution to sales in local currency so planners can prioritize purchasing and replenishment. The report uses the shared ABC Analysis Setup thresholds by default. Users can override them for a run, filter by item, location or date, and include items with zero sales.

feature: ABC Analysis report in the Inventory Power BI app
description: Shows how much each inventory class contributes to sales, with item counts, sales amounts, sales quantities and share of sales. The classification uses sales in local currency and the same ABC Analysis Setup thresholds as the built-in Business Central report.

feature: Spain — Choose the operation date used in SII invoice XML
description: The Spanish SII reporting workflow can use either the posting date or the document date as the operation date in the XML submitted to the tax authorities.

feature: Use the modular System Application foundation in AL extensions
description: The first modular System Application provides reusable AL components for capabilities shared by extensions, separate from the Base Application business logic. Its initial modules include Assisted Setup, which centralizes pages used by guided setup experiences.

feature: Inspect global variables faster in the debugger
description: Improves the performance of inspecting global variables while debugging Business Central.

feature: Improve SQL connection authentication performance in Business Central online
description: Improves the performance of SQL connection authentication in Business Central online.

feature: Set dimension codes when inserting dimension values through web services
description: Makes the dimension code editable on a dimension value so a web service call can provide the code when inserting the value.

feature: Improve recovery from SQL Server crashes during app installation
description: Improves Business Central recovery when SQL Server crashes during an application installation.

feature: Improve memory allocation during server startup
description: Improves how Business Central Server allocates memory during startup.

feature: Improve thread allocation for web service endpoints
description: Improves how Business Central allocates threads reserved for web service endpoints.

feature: Use a date formula for the VAT report reminder
description: The reminder time field in VAT Report Setup uses the DateFormula type. A date formula expresses the reminder interval relative to a date.

feature: Improve the reliability of user cache persistence
description: Improves the reliability of saving user cache data in Business Central.

feature: Improve Copilot performance
description: Improves Copilot performance in Business Central.

feature: Use Sticky Scroll in the AL editor
description: Enables Sticky Scroll for AL code in Visual Studio Code, keeping enclosing code scopes visible while scrolling.

feature: Go to definition from the AL Rec keyword
description: Enables Go to Definition for Rec in AL, allowing developers to navigate to the associated record definition.

feature: Include ClientType in telemetry event RT0019
description: Adds ClientType as a custom dimension to telemetry event RT0019 so it can be analyzed by client type.

feature: Include SQL row and statement metrics in telemetry event RT0018
description: Adds SqlRowsRead and SQLStatements as custom dimensions to RT0018 telemetry. These values let analysts inspect database work associated with the event.

feature: Import and export configuration packages with special characters in field names
description: Excel import and export for configuration packages accepts special characters such as a percent sign in field names.

feature: Reclaim memory allocated by memory streams
description: Business Central can reclaim memory allocated by memory streams.

feature: Send multiple documents in SII
description: Adds a method for sending multiple documents through Spain’s Immediate Supply of Information (SII) reporting workflow.

feature: Set inherent permissions on AL objects
description: AL objects that support permissions can specify inherent permissions with the InherentPermissions property. The property is available from runtime 11.0 and cannot be customized.

feature: Use folder paths for control add-in resources
description: Control add-ins can reference images, scripts, and stylesheets in a folder using a wildcard instead of listing each resource path individually.

feature: Define Copilot prompt actions on AL pages
description: AL developers can use area(Prompting) to expose actions that launch Copilot features on supported page types. Depending on the page, the actions can appear in a floating action bar or elsewhere in the interface.

feature: Read the current call stack without raising an error
description: The SessionInformation.CallStack method returns the current AL call stack without raising an exception. It is available from AL runtime 15.0.

feature: Host a single user control on an AL page
description: The UserControlHost page type hosts a single user control in an AL page. It is available from runtime 15.0.

feature: Maintain Microsoft Entra sign-in with Chrome SameSite cookie changes
description: Cumulative Update 13 updates the on-premises platform so Microsoft Entra authentication continues to work when Chrome changes its default SameSite cookie policy. Microsoft identifies CU 13 as the minimum recommended update for the October 2018 release. Deployments using a web farm may also need to configure the session affinity cookie.
